title: V-JEPA 2 Meets AQA: Phase-Based Scoring and Reference-Based Feedback for Mountain Biking
summary: We study mountain-bike action quality assessment (AQA) with weak labels and candidate feedback. The training corpus comprises 95 field-recorded jump clips with binary labels denoting good or poor technique. These are coarse categorical labels, not continuous expert quality scores; phase-boundary and aspect-level annotations are unavailable. Our pipeline summarizes four heuristic phases using frozen V-JEPA 2 video features and two-dimensional pose and motion measurements. A small transformer predicts a binary-label score. A separate reference layer compares phase-specific measurements with those of clips labelled as good technique to propose phase, body-parameter, and direction cues. We detail the measurements, network, and evaluation so that the limits of each output are explicit. In five-fold clip-level cross-validation, the full scorer obtained pooled out-of-fold AUROC 0.768 and average precision 0.812. These are exploratory figures because the reporting fold also selected the neural training epoch and riders were not separated between folds. Removing biomechanical scoring inputs raised AUROC to 0.809. A separate inner-selection run obtained AUROC 0.678, but used about 57 rather than 76 training clips per outer fold, so its difference from the test-selected run does not quantify selection bias. The unsupervised aspect head did not learn distinct factors. On a 17-clip external probe, an earlier checkpoint obtained binary accuracy 0.412 and Spearman association -0.135 with expert scores. Candidate cues had precision 0.118 and recall 1.0 against each of two coaches, with substantial disagreement about direction. These findings do not establish rider-independent scoring or reliable corrective feedback; they identify the empirical work needed to evaluate either use.

AI.tldr: 这篇摘要研究山地车跳跃动作质量评估（AQA），使用95段仅含“好/差”弱标签的视频，结合V-JEPA 2视频特征、2D姿态和运动测量，以及一个小型Transformer预测二进制标签分数；同时用参考层与“好”样本比较，提出阶段、身体参数和方向纠正提示。结果显示模型表现有限且不稳定，不能支持骑手无关评分或可靠纠正反馈。
AI.motivation: 该研究针对动作质量评估中缺乏连续专家评分、阶段边界标注和细粒度动作方面标注的现实问题，试图在弱监督条件下评估骑手跳跃技术，并探索能否生成对教练有参考价值的纠正性反馈。
AI.method: 方法包括：使用95段现场录制跳跃视频和二元好坏标签；基于四个启发式阶段，提取冻结V-JEPA 2视频特征以及2D姿态和运动指标；训练小型Transformer输出接近二进制标签的评分；另设参考层，将当前片段与标注为“好”的片段进行阶段内测量比较，提出阶段、身体参数和纠正方向等候选提示；通过五折片段级交叉验证和17段外部探针评估模型。
AI.result: 完整评分器在五折交叉验证中得到池化出折AUROC 0.768、AP 0.812，但这些结果具探索性，因为折内同时选择神经网络训练轮次，且骑手未在折间隔离。移除生物力学评分输入后AUROC反而升至0.809。另一单独内选择运行AUROC为0.678，但训练片段数不同，不能直接量化选择偏差。无监督方面头未学到可区分因子。外部17段探针上，早期检查点二元准确率仅0.412，与专家评分的Spearman相关为-0.135。候选提示相对两位教练的精确率仅0.118、召回率为1.0，且方向判断存在明显分歧。
AI.conclusion: 该摘要表明当前方法无法建立稳健、骑手无关的动作质量评分，也无法证明可靠纠正反馈的有效性；其主要贡献在于清晰暴露评估设计、标签粒度和指标局限性，并指出后续需要更严格的折间隔离、独立验证、细粒度标注和专家反馈评估工作。

title: EgoHand: Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
comment: Authors are listed alphabetically. Project leads are Chao-Yeh Chen, Tiffany Chen, and Umar Iqbal
summary: We introduce EgoHand, a monocular 3D hand reconstruction model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video. Central to our approach is the curation of a high-quality training corpus of 14 million images, combining synthetic data, in-the-wild video, and multi-camera motion capture to balance scene diversity and supervision quality. The model adopts SOMA-Hand as its parametric representation and processes 2D hand crops with a transformer encoder, incorporating camera cues and an auxiliary 2D branch to improve geometric consistency and image alignment. Zero-shot evaluations on HOT3D, ARCTIC, and H2O demonstrate strong out-of-domain generalization, with lower joint-position, root-translation, and acceleration errors than competing baselines at an inference latency of approximately 9.69 ms. A blinded user preference study further shows that participants favor EgoHand's reconstructed hand poses over those from Apple EgoDex and Ropedia Xperience-10M. We release the EgoHand model and source code under the OpenMDW license, allowing free commercial use of the model.

AI.tldr: EgoHand 是一种面向第一视角视频的单体三维手部重建模型，结合高质量混合训练数据、SOMA-Hand 参数化表示和基于 Transformer 的 2D 手部裁剪编码，在跨数据集零样本评测中取得更优精度与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 在自视角视频中，单体三维手部重建面临场景多样性强、观测尺度变化大、手与相机几何关系复杂以及真实高质量标注不足等挑战。作者旨在构建一个既能泛化到不同数据集、又能高效运行的开源手部重建模型。
AI.method: EgoHand 以 SOMA-Hand 作为参数化手部表示，对输入图像中的 2D 手部裁剪区域使用 Transformer 编码器进行三维姿态与形状预测。训练数据由约 1400 万张高质量图像组成，包括合成数据、野外视频数据和多相机动作捕捉数据，以兼顾场景多样性与监督质量。模型还引入相机线索，并设计辅助 2D 分支，以增强几何一致性和图像对齐能力。
AI.result: 在 HOT3D、ARCTIC 和 H2O 数据集上进行零样本评测时，EgoHand 表现出较强的域外泛化能力，在关节位置误差、根节点平移误差和加速度误差等指标上优于对比基线，推理延迟约为 9.69 ms。盲测用户偏好实验显示，参与者更偏好 EgoHand 重建出的手部姿态，相较于 Apple EgoDex 和 Ropedia Xperience-10M 具有更好的主观质量。
AI.conclusion: EgoHand 通过高质量混合训练数据、参数化手部表示、相机条件编码和辅助 2D 监督分支，实现了单体自视角视频下高精度、高效率且可商用的三维手部重建。其开源发布为相关研究与实际应用提供了可复用基础。

title: R4DGS: Referring Segmentation in 4D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. Project page: https://chenbangpu.github.io/R4DGS/
summary: Dynamic representations based on 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) have shown strong capabilities in reconstruction and rendering, yet current methods remain limited in supporting complex natural-language referring in dynamic scenes. Existing 4D Gaussian methods are primarily designed for rendering-oriented dynamic modeling, while current semantic extensions often rely on scene-specific semantic optimization or are evaluated on relatively simple query settings. In this paper, we study Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting (R4DGS), a task for grounding temporally varying, multi-target or reasoning-intensive, and zero-target or distractor expressions in dynamic 4D scenes. To support this task, we introduce R4D-Bench-QA, a benchmark with structured query annotations. We further present ReferGaussian, a unified framework built upon 4DGS that converts low-level dynamic Gaussians into persistent, language-addressable entities for training-free referring inference. ReferGaussian organizes mask-supported Gaussian entities in an EntityBank, uses Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to decompose complex queries into trackable object phrases and structured referring constraints, and performs constraint-aware grounding without scene-specific semantic optimization. Experiments on R4D-Bench-QA and the 4D LangSplat protocol demonstrate improved temporal target selection and competitive spatiotemporal grounding without scene-specific semantic training. Project resources are available at https://chenbangpu.github.io/R4DGS/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向动态4D高斯场景的自然语言指代接地任务R4DGS，并构建基准R4D-Bench-QA与训练无关框架ReferGaussian，实现复杂查询下的时序目标选择与时空定位。
AI.motivation: 现有4DGS方法主要面向动态场景重建与渲染，语义扩展通常依赖特定场景的语义优化或较简单的查询评测，难以支持动态场景中包含时间变化、多目标、推理密集、零目标和干扰项的复杂自然语言指代。
AI.method: 作者首先定义Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting任务，并构建包含结构化查询标注的R4D-Bench-QA基准。随后提出ReferGaussian框架：在4DGS基础上将低层动态高斯组织为持续存在、可被语言寻址的实体，并建立EntityBank；利用多模态大语言模型将复杂自然语言查询分解为可追踪目标短语和结构化指代约束；通过约束感知接地进行训练无关推理，不需要针对场景的语义优化。
AI.result: 在R4D-Bench-QA和4D LangSplat评测协议上的实验表明，该方法能够提升动态场景中的时序目标选择能力，并在不进行场景特定语义训练的情况下取得有竞争力的时空指代接地性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将4DGS从偏渲染导向的动态表示扩展为支持复杂自然语言指代的语义可交互表示，提供了动态4D场景中的训练无关指代接地框架与评测基准，推动动态场景理解与交互式指代定位研究。

title: MoRE: Motion-Regularized Encoding for Articulated 3D Generation
summary: Generating an articulated object from a single image requires recovering both its appearance and the mechanism governing its parts. A compact encoding of joint attributes does not by itself ensure that reconstruction preserves the resulting motion. We present MoRE, Motion-Regularized Encoding for articulated 3D generation. MoRE represents coordinate-aligned joint lines with axis classification and two axis-orthogonal Plücker moment coefficients, removing the arbitrary choice of an origin along the axis. During representation learning, decoded joint hypotheses are used to move corresponding three-dimensional anchors, and their motions are compared with those of annotated joints. A differentiable expectation over joint types and axis directions couples attribute reconstruction to the motion it induces. An image-conditioned flow learns the resulting functional latents, while a multi-state-adapted Gaussian model supplies appearance. At inference, recovered part assignments and joints articulate a single set of rest-pose Gaussians without regenerating the object for each state. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility and ACD show stronger part-box agreement, articulated-state geometry and visual similarity than the compared baselines, while joint prediction reduces axis, origin and range errors relative to ArtiLatent. Controlled ablations support the joint-line encoding and show that motion supervision reduces anchor-motion error. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be released in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoRE（Motion-Regularized Encoding），一种用于从单张图像生成可活动 3D 物体的运动正则化编码方法。其核心是将关节表示为坐标对齐的关节线，并用轴分类和两个与轴正交的 Plücker 矩系数来消除轴原点的任意性；同时通过运动监督将关节属性重建与其诱导的实际运动耦合，从而更准确地恢复部件、关节和外观。
AI.motivation: 从单张图像生成可活动物体不仅需要恢复物体外观，还需要理解驱动各部件运动的机械结构。已有方法即使编码了紧凑的关节属性，也可能无法保证重建后的几何真正保持正确的运动关系。因此，需要一种能够同时学习关节表示、部件划分和运动一致性的 3D 生成方法。
AI.method: MoRE 将每个关节表示为坐标对齐的关节线，采用轴分类以及两个与轴正交的 Plücker 矩系数，避免沿轴任意选择原点。在表示学习阶段，模型用解码得到的关节假设移动对应的三维锚点，并将这些运动与标注关节产生的运动进行比较。一个可微的期望机制对关节类型和轴方向进行建模，使属性重建与其诱导的运动相互耦合。图像条件流模型学习这种功能化潜在表示，而多状态适配的高斯模型提供外观。推理时，模型利用恢复的部件分配和关节参数对一组静态姿态高斯进行驱动，无需为每个运动状态重新生成物体。
AI.result: 在 PartNet-Mobility 和 ACD 数据集上的实验表明，MoRE 在部件与边界框一致性、可活动状态几何质量以及视觉相似度方面优于对比基线。与 ArtiLatent 相比，MoRE 在关节预测中显著降低了轴方向、原点和运动范围误差。受控消融实验进一步验证了关节线编码的有效性，并表明运动监督能够降低锚点运动误差。
AI.conclusion: MoRE 通过运动正则化的关节线编码和可微运动监督，将关节属性重建与实际运动绑定，从而提升单图可活动 3D 生成的部件、关节和几何准确性。该方法能够在不重复生成物体的情况下驱动静态高斯表示实现多状态运动，为可活动物体生成提供了更一致的表示与训练范式。

title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
summary: We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by $13.4\%$ relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.

AI.tldr: Foundation4D 是一个面向多相机驾驶视频的统一前馈模型，同时完成几何估计、3D 检测、语义占用预测和高斯场景重建，并发布 PAI-Foundation4D 基准。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中的 4D 场景理解涉及几何、目标、语义和重建等多个任务，但这些任务常被分开建模，难以共享时空信息，也缺少高质量密集标注数据。
AI.method: 模型采用共享主干和因子化时空注意力来跨相机与跨时间融合观测；推理时通过位姿图优化细化相机轨迹并跨输入窗口组装目标轨迹；同时构建数据标注管线，并支持任务联合训练与无激光雷达的 NuRec 场景重建。
AI.result: 在 Waymo、nuScenes、OpenOccupancy 等基准上取得领先的深度、检测和占用指标；联合训练使 top-class mAP 提升 1.2，并将相机到 rig 平移误差相对降低 13.4%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的前馈 4D 感知模型能够有效共享几何与语义信息，提升多任务性能，并为无激光雷达驾驶场景重建和仿真应用提供可行方案。

title: FiLM-CAM: Keyed Feature Modulation for Conditional-Access Watermarking
summary: We propose FiLM-CAM; a conditional-access image watermarking approach that enforces authorized encoding, decoding, and removal through keyed feature modulation. A secret key conditions a Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) mechanism that transforms the internal representation of the watermark signal before embedding, thereby coupling the payload to the key at the feature, rather than pixel level. The same key must be presented to condition the decoder to correctly recover the payload embedded in an image. To enforce conditional access, we train the system to maximize the performance gap between authorized and unauthorized use, ensuring reliable extraction under the correct key while inducing failure under incorrect keys. In addition, we design our encoder to estimate the watermark residual invariant to the presence of pre-existing watermarks. This design enables conditional watermark removal via simple re-encoding and subtraction of the residual using iterative refinement, contingent on knowledge of the secret key. We evaluate FiLM-CAM across multiple watermarking encoder-decoder backbones, demonstrating that keyed feature modulation serves as an effective, architecture-agnostic conditional access module (CAM) for image watermarking.

AI.tldr: FiLM-CAM 提出一种基于密钥条件化特征调制（FiLM）的条件访问图像水印方法，使合法编码、解码和移除水印都必须依赖秘密密钥，从而防止未授权提取与去除。
AI.motivation: 现有图像水印方案通常在授权控制方面不足：如果攻击者能够访问编码器、解码器或水印信号，可能未经授权提取或移除水印。因此需要一种机制，将水印的嵌入、恢复和去除都绑定到秘密密钥，实现条件访问。
AI.method: 该方法利用秘密密钥条件化 Feature-wise Linear Modulation（FiLM）模块，对水印信号的内部特征表示进行调制，使水印载荷与密钥在特征层面耦合。编码器和解码器都必须在对应密钥条件下才能正常工作。训练目标是最大化授权密钥与错误密钥之间的性能差距，使正确密钥下可靠提取、错误密钥下提取失败。此外，编码器被设计为估计对已有水印具有不变性的水印残差，从而在已知密钥的情况下，通过重新编码并减去残差进行迭代优化，实现条件化水印移除。
AI.result: 在多种水印编码-解码骨干网络上的实验表明，基于密钥的特征调制能够作为架构无关的条件访问模块（CAM），在不同 backbone 上有效实现授权提取和授权移除。
AI.conclusion: FiLM-CAM 通过 keyed feature modulation 将访问控制从像素层面提升到特征层面，为图像水印提供了可靠的秘密密钥绑定机制，同时支持条件化的水印嵌入、提取与移除，具有较好的通用性和安全性。

title: Latent Space Jam: Layout Guided Video Synthesis
summary: Adding control to video generation often requires training, which demands additional computational resources, data, or architectural changes. We propose a training-free approach that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion using coarse layouts. Our method operates in two passes: first, it steers spatiotemporal placement through prompt-guided cross-attention to produce a coarse visual guide; second, this guide conditions the same model to generate a high-quality, layoutconsistent video. The approach enables coordinated motion with strong temporal consistency, supporting diverse trajectories and object interactions without additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, as well as visual quality across static, dynamic, and multi-object scene settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的 video diffusion 方法，利用预训练模型和粗布局通过两阶段生成实现物体位置、运动和轨迹控制，在重叠、轨迹精度、时序一致性和视觉质量上优于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成控制通常需要额外训练、更多算力、数据或模型结构改动，成本高且不便。作者希望在不训练的前提下，利用预训练视频扩散模型实现物体布局和运动的可控生成。
AI.method: 方法为两阶段免训练控制：第一阶段通过 prompt 引导的 cross-attention 调整时空布局，生成粗略视觉引导；第二阶段将该粗引导作为条件，输入同一预训练视频扩散模型，生成高质量且布局一致的视频。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法在静态、动态和多物体场景中，相比先前方法在物体重叠控制、轨迹精度、时间一致性、物体交互和视觉质量方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，通过预训练视频扩散模型的两阶段粗到细控制流程，可在不增加训练成本的情况下实现视频生成中的布局与运动控制，具有实用性和扩展性。

title: VisCurate: Evaluating Behavioral Equivalence of Visual Skills
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027), Main Conference
summary: Modern vision-based agents have shifted toward skill-based problem-solving, where a skill is an executable image-to-image operation, e.g., cropping, thresholding, or edge detection. As these skill libraries grow, they accumulate duplicated, mislabeled, and defective skills. The signals normally used to curate them (a skill's name, description, or source code) say little about how the skill visually changes the image. We present VisCurate, a framework and benchmark that curates visual skill libraries from observed execution rather than from text. VisCurate runs each candidate skill pair on a shared probe battery and assigns one of six behavioral relations, each tied to a library edit that is safe to make. The benchmark injects seven defect types into a clean library at controlled rates, producing 300 reproducible instances with ground-truth relations and repairs. While text baselines accept up to five of six false merges on hard negatives, our verifier accepts none and recovers 51.2% of the pairs that are truly mergeable. On two real, uncurated libraries, VisCurate finds that 92% of the skills a package shares with its downstream copy are redundant, while execution confirms only 10 of 17 published equivalence claims. The curation problem also remains open, as the strongest of the nine automated curators recovers only about half of the repairs. We emphasize that visual skill libraries should be curated by behavior, not by description.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 VisCurate，一种基于执行行为而非文本描述来整理视觉技能库的框架与基准，并通过六类行为关系指导安全的库编辑，实验表明文本基线难以避免错误合并，而行为验证更可靠，但自动整理仍有较大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉智能体逐渐采用可执行的图像到图像技能，如裁剪、二值化、边缘检测等。随着技能库规模增长，库中会出现重复、错标或有缺陷的技能。传统整理依赖技能名称、描述或源代码，但这些文本信号无法充分反映技能对图像的视觉操作差异，因此需要基于实际执行行为的整理机制。
AI.method: VisCurate 通过运行候选技能对，并在共享探针输入集上观察其执行结果，为每对技能分配六类行为关系之一，每类关系对应一种可安全执行的库编辑操作。作者构建基准：在干净技能库中注入七种缺陷类型，以受控比例生成 300 个可复现实例，并提供真实关系与修复标注。实验比较了文本基线、行为验证器以及多种自动整理器在合成基准和两个真实未整理库上的表现。
AI.result: 在硬负样本上，文本基线最多接受五种六类错误合并，而 VisCurate 的行为验证器未接受任何错误合并，并恢复 51.2% 真正可合并的技能对。在两个真实未整理技能库中，VisCurate 发现某软件包与其下游副本共享的技能中有 92% 是冗余的；同时，在 17 项已发表等价性声明中，仅 10 项得到执行验证支持。此外，问题仍未完全解决：九种自动整理器中最强方法也只能恢复约一半修复。
AI.conclusion: 视觉技能库的整理应以可观察的视觉行为为依据，而不是依赖名称、描述或源码等文本线索。该工作强调了行为驱动技能验证的必要性与当前自动整理能力的不足，为后续更可靠、可复现的技能库维护与视觉智能体系统建设提供了框架和基准。

title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures. Project page: https://seemandhar.github.io/splatlab
summary: Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed. Prior autonomous-research systems read papers, draft hypotheses, and write code, but are limited by short fixed templates, low executability, and weak traceability, and none has been demonstrated end-to-end in a live computer-vision subfield with intense activity. SplatLab is an autonomous research system for 3D Gaussian Splatting that addresses these limitations. Given a research prompt, a target-paper URL, or no input at all, it reproduces a published baseline, proposes an extension, trains and ablates across Mip-NeRF 360 and LLFF, writes the manuscript, and binds every reported number to a logged training run. Five design choices distinguish it: (i) candidates mutate plugins from a verified-reproduction backbone matched to published baselines; (ii) a cascade-weighted Elo tournament across eight islands scores candidates on measured GPU PSNR with verbal-gradient feedback; (iii) a standing falsifier subtracts Elo on failure, integrating stress-test survival into selection; (iv) every reported number is bound to a logged training run, and the run cannot terminate while any claim is unbacked; (v) a seven-category 3DGS taxonomy wraps EVOLVE-BLOCK markers in domain-aligned scaffolds transferable across 3DGS repositories. On PSNR-targeted runs, SplatLab's manuscripts beat their reproduced targets by +0.18 to +3.78 dB, including +3.78 dB on astrophotographic nebula rendering, for which no prior 3DGS method exists. The research cycle compresses from months of graduate-student time to days of mostly autonomous compute. Code, all manuscripts, experiment ledgers, and the cross-run paper store are available on the project page.

AI.tldr: SplatLab 是一个面向 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）的自主科研系统，可从论文 URL 或零输入开始复现已发表基线、提出并训练扩展方案、运行消融实验、撰写论文，并将每个数值结果绑定到可追踪的训练记录，从而把原本数月的复现与拓展过程压缩到数天的近似自主计算流程。
AI.motivation: 复现已发表 3DGS 论文通常需要数周专家工程工作，阻碍后续方法扩展。既有自主科研系统虽能读论文、提假设和写代码，但受限于固定模板、代码可执行性不足和结果可追溯性弱，并且尚未在高度活跃的计算机视觉子领域中完成端到端验证。
AI.method: 系统围绕五个设计选择构建：（1）候选方法从经验证且与已发表基线匹配的复现主干中突变插件生成；（2）使用级联加权 Elo 锦标赛，在八个隔离种群中根据 GPU 上实测 PSNR 和语言梯度反馈评分候选；（3）通过“常驻反证器”在失败时扣除 Elo 分数，将压力测试存活情况纳入选择；（4）每个报告数值必须绑定到日志化训练运行，否则运行不能结束；（5）采用七类 3DGS 分类法，用 EVOLVE-BLOCK 标记组织领域对齐代码骨架，便于跨 3DGS 代码库迁移。流程包括复现目标论文、提出扩展、在 Mip-NeRF 360 和 LLFF 上训练与消融、生成论文和实验账本。
AI.result: 在以 PSNR 为目标的运行中，SplatLab 生成的论文相对于其复现目标取得 +0.18 至 +3.78 dB 的 PSNR 提升；其中在天文摄影星云渲染任务上提升 3.78 dB，而该任务此前没有已有 3DGS 方法。整体科研周期从研究生数月的时间缩短到数天、且主要由自主计算完成。项目公开代码、论文、实验记录、跨运行论文存储库等资源。
AI.conclusion: SplatLab 表明，将可验证复现主干、基于实测指标的候选筛选、可追溯结果绑定和领域化代码组织结合后，可以在活跃的 3DGS 子领域中实现从论文复现、方法扩展到自动撰写和审计的端到端自主科研闭环。

title: AVAtt: A Free-Viewing Eye-Tracking Dataset and Benchmark for Visual Attention on Paintings
summary:
Saliency and scanpath models are developed almost exclusively on natural photographs, yet paintings are composed by artists to guide the viewer's eye and differ from photographs in texture, colour and abstraction. We introduce \avatt, a free-viewing eye-tracking dataset on 
Images{} paintings spanning sixteen art movements and five centuries, with 
Scanpaths{} scanpaths and 
Fixations{} fixations from 
Participants{} participants (\spPerImageMin--\spPerImageMax{} observers per painting). For every painting we release individual scanpaths with fixation timing and eye--screen distance, fixation maps, saliency maps smoothed at one degree of visual angle, temporal saliency videos and rich art metadata. We benchmark classic and deep saliency models against human agreement, revealing substantial headroom for art-aware models, and rank 44 scanpath-similarity measures, including a new language-free family of image-encoder metrics built on ten CNN, ViT and self-supervised encoders. With controls that remove viewing biases, we show that faces are fixated  aceEnrich$	imes$ more than expected and within half a second, that local structure draws the eye, that composition rules fitted from image content predict where people look, and that art style shapes how much viewers agree. Dataset, code and a Python package are available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Amine-CV/AVAtt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AVAtt：一个面向绘画作品的自由观看眼动数据集与基准评测框架，用于研究观看者在不同艺术流派画作上的显著性分布、扫描路径和注视行为。
AI.motivation: 现有显著性与扫描路径模型主要基于自然照片训练和评测，而绘画作品是艺术家主动组织构图、颜色、纹理和抽象元素的结果，与照片存在明显视觉结构差异。因此，需要专门的绘画眼动数据和模型评测，来理解绘画如何引导观看者注意。
AI.method: 作者构建并开放了覆盖多个艺术流派和五个世纪的大规模绘画眼动数据集，包含大量 paintings、scanpaths、fixations 和多参与者观察数据。每个绘画提供逐注视扫描路径、注视时间、眼-屏距离、注视图、经一度视角平滑的显著性图、时间显著性视频以及艺术元数据。进一步以人类一致性为目标，评测经典模型和深度显著性模型；比较 44 种扫描路径相似度指标，并提出基于 10 种 CNN、ViT 和自监督图像编码器的语言无关相似度家族。通过控制观看偏差，分析面孔、局部结构、构图规则和绘画风格对注视行为的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有显著性模型在绘画上的表现仍明显低于人类一致性，说明艺术感知模型仍有较大提升空间。研究还发现，观看者在半秒内会显著更频繁地注视人脸区域，局部图像结构强烈吸引注意，从图像内容拟合出的构图规则能够预测注视位置，而艺术风格会显著影响观看者之间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: AVAtt 为艺术视觉认知、绘画显著性预测和扫描路径建模提供了大规模数据、统一评测指标和可复现工具，推动显著性研究从自然照片扩展到具有人工组织视觉结构的艺术图像领域。

title: Unified Trajectory and 3D Pose Forecasting for Multi-Agent Sports Analysis
summary: Forecasting future human motion requires jointly reasoning about an agent's global trajectory and 3D body pose, which are tightly coupled, particularly in team sports where multiple interacting players introduce complex social dynamics. We exploit a socio-temporal encoder that fuses trajectory and pose at the input level and models them jointly through shared factorized attention. The model is further enhanced by a per-joint loss reweighting scheme that emphasizes dynamic joints and prevents degenerate solutions, and a frequency-domain trajectory smoothing term that improves trajectory prediction while indirectly benefiting pose forecasting. To ensure fair comparison with prior joint forecasting methods, we identify and correct evaluation biases arising from overlapping sequence construction, adopting instead a non-overlapping protocol and a deterministic, oracle-free strategy for multi-future prediction. Our approach improves over prior joint forecasting methods on both WorldPose and 3DPW, with the largest gains on pose accuracy, demonstrating that the proposed joint formulation generalizes beyond the densely interactive scenarios that motivate it.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个社会-时间编码器，在输入层融合行人的全局轨迹与3D身体姿态，并通过共享分解注意力联合建模；同时引入关节动态重加权损失、频域轨迹平滑项，以及修正后的公平评测协议，提升了多智能体交互场景下的人类运动预测性能。
AI.motivation: 预测未来人体运动需要同时推理全局轨迹和3D姿态，两者高度耦合，尤其在团队运动等存在多人互动、复杂社会动态的场景中更明显。现有方法往往未能充分联合建模轨迹与姿态，且评测中存在由序列重叠构造引起的偏差，需要更公平的协议。
AI.method: 方法包括：构建 socio-temporal encoder，在输入阶段融合轨迹与姿态，并采用共享 factorized attention 联合建模；提出 per-joint loss reweighting，强调动态关节并防止退化解；加入频域 trajectory smoothing term，以改善轨迹预测并间接提升姿态预测；针对先前方法的评测偏差，采用非重叠序列构造协议，并使用确定性、不依赖 oracle 的多未来预测策略。
AI.result: 在 WorldPose 和 3DPW 数据集上，该方法优于先前联合轨迹与姿态预测方法，其中姿态精度提升最大，说明其联合建模范式即使超出密集互动的团队运动场景也能泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过输入层联合表示、共享注意力、关节动态损失重加权、频域轨迹平滑以及公平评测协议，本文显著提升了人类运动轨迹与3D姿态的联合预测性能，并证明了该联合建模框架的有效性与泛化能力。

title: Visual Grounding First, Multimodal In-context Learning Follows
summary: LLMs have shown strong in-context learning (ICL) capability, but extending it to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) remains challenging. Prior multimodal ICL methods often rely on ICL-specific datasets for additional training or task vector extraction, which can improve performance on the same ICL benchmark used for adaptation. However, they do not generalize well to other benchmarks and often induce forgetting in previously well-solved tasks. For this reason, we identify 'visual grounding' as the key bottleneck in multimodal ICL; MLLMs often fail to attend to task-relevant visual evidence in demonstrations, instead over-relying on textual cues and producing hallucinated outputs. To address this, we propose ProCoRe to enhance visual grounding through contrastive reinforcement learning on multimodal contrastive data for improving multimodal ICL. ProCoRe generates captions for contrastive image pairs, decomposes them into propositions, and optimizes contrastive rewards that encourage alignment with corresponding images while discouraging mismatched ones. Despite never seeing ICL-formatted training examples, ProCoRe improves average multimodal ICL classification accuracy by 5.6% and captioning ROUGE-L by 13.8% over the off-the-shelf Qwen-VL-3-8B model, outperforming ICL-data-dependent state of the arts across benchmarks. Finally, we introduce PICL, a personalized multimodal ICL captioning benchmark that tests whether MLLMs genuinely understand visual demonstrations rather than relying on pre-trained semantic priors.

AI.tldr: 本文指出多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在上下文学习（ICL）中的核心瓶颈是“视觉定位/视觉证据对齐”不足：模型常过度依赖文本线索并产生幻觉。作者提出 ProCoRe，通过对比强化学习提升多模态对比数据中的视觉 grounding，并引入个性化多模态 ICL captioning 基准 PICL。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 ICL 方法通常依赖专门的 ICL 数据集进行额外训练或任务向量抽取，能在同一 ICL benchmark 上提升性能，但跨 benchmark 泛化差，且容易遗忘原本已解决的任务。作者认为，问题不只是训练格式或任务适配，而是 MLLM 未能充分关注演示中任务相关的视觉证据，导致依赖语言先验或文本提示并产生幻觉。
AI.method: 提出 ProCoRe。该方法构造多模态对比数据中的图像对，为对比图像生成 caption，并将 caption 分解为命题（propositions）。随后通过对比强化学习优化奖励：鼓励 caption/命题与对应图像一致，惩罚与不匹配图像关联，从而增强模型对视觉细节的 grounded understanding。
AI.result: 尽管训练过程中从未使用 ICL 格式样例，ProCoRe 相比直接使用 Qwen-VL-3-8B，多模态 ICL 分类平均准确率提升 5.6%，caption 的 ROUGE-L 提升 13.8%，并超越依赖 ICL 数据的现有 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 视觉 grounding 是制约 MLLM ICL 泛化能力的关键因素。通过对比强化学习增强视觉对齐，可在不专门训练 ICL 样例的情况下显著提升多模态 ICL 性能，并减少跨基准泛化失败与灾难性遗忘。同时提出的 PICL 基准能够检验模型是否真正理解视觉演示，而非依赖预训练语义先验。

title: KinoUAV: A Benchmark for Safe and Stable UAV Vision-Language Navigation with Kinodynamic Modeling
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have recently emerged as important remote sensing platforms, and UAV navigation has shown great potential in remote sensing applications. However, existing methods do not explicitly incorporate kinodynamic modeling or safety distances into trajectory generation, resulting in high absolute yaw rates, frequent collisions, and low navigation success rates, which limit safety and motion stability. To address this challenge, we introduce KinoUAV, a kinodynamic benchmark comprising a dataset and KinoUAV-Agent. First, we develop a hierarchical kinodynamic trajectory generation pipeline that drives UAV through acceleration actions. It uses waypoint chains from global planning and generates trajectories segment by segment under velocity, acceleration, and jerk constraints, reducing oscillations and improving trajectory stability. Furthermore, we introduce directional free-space distance (DFD) labels into the constructed dataset to describe the available clearance for safe motion decisions. The proposed KinoUAV-Agent predicts DFDs and uses them to generate safe actions, decoupling perception from action decision-making. This design enables autonomous obstacle avoidance and improves navigation safety. The benchmark incorporates the proposed Cruise-Seek task, in which the UAV first enters the target region and then searches for the target, reducing the difficulty of target search and improving navigation success. Experiments on KinoUAV show that KinoUAV-Agent outperforms existing methods, achieving the highest success rate while maintaining lower absolute yaw rates and collision rates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of kinodynamic modeling for safe and stable UAV navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向无人机安全稳定导航的动力学基准与智能体方法KinoUAV，通过动力学轨迹生成、方向自由空间距离标签和Cruise-Seek任务，提升复杂环境中障碍规避能力与导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机导航方法在轨迹生成中缺乏对运动动力学建模和安全距离的显式考虑，导致偏航角速度过大、碰撞频发、导航成功率低，制约其在遥感等应用中的安全性与运动稳定性。
AI.method: 本文构建KinoUAV基准，包括数据集和KinoUAV-Agent。首先设计分层动力学轨迹生成流程，将全局路径规划得到的路点链逐段转化为满足速度、加速度和加加速度约束的轨迹，以降低振荡并提高轨迹稳定性；其次引入方向自由空间距离标签，用于刻画不同运动方向上可用于安全移动的剩余空间；最后设计KinoUAV-Agent，通过预测DFD生成安全动作，将感知与动作决策解耦，并引入Cruise-Seek任务，使无人机先进入目标区域再搜索目标，从而降低目标搜索难度、提高导航成功率。
AI.result: 在KinoUAV基准上的实验表明，KinoUAV-Agent优于现有方法，能够取得最高导航成功率，同时保持更低的绝对偏航率和碰撞率，验证了动力学建模对提升无人机导航安全性与稳定性的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将运动动力学约束与可量化安全距离信息纳入无人机轨迹生成和决策，是解决低空复杂环境自主导航中稳定性、避障和安全性问题的重要方向；KinoUAV为后续无人机导航研究提供了数据、建模方法和评估基准。

title: GSHeadRelight: Fast Relightability for 3D Gaussian Head Synthesis
summary: Relighting and novel view synthesis of human portraits are essential in applications such as portrait photography, virtual reality (VR), and augmented reality (AR). Despite recent progress, 3D-aware portrait relighting remains challenging due to the demands for photorealistic rendering, real-time performance, and generalization to unseen subjects. Existing works either rely on supervision from limited and expensive light stage captured data or produce suboptimal results. Moreover, many works are based on generative NeRFs, which suffer from poor 3D consistency and low real-time performance. We resort to recent progress on generative 3D Gaussians and design a lighting model based on a unified neural radiance transfer representation, which responds linearly to incident light. Using only in-the-wild images, our method achieves state-of-the-art relighting results and a significantly faster rendering speed ($\times12$) compared to previous 3D-aware portrait relighting research. Project page: http://www.geometrylearning.com/GSHeadRelight/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于生成式3D高斯和统一神经辐射传输表示的人像重光照与新视角合成方法，仅使用野外图像即可实现高质量、实时、跨未见主体的3D感知人像重光照。
AI.motivation: 人像重光照和新视角合成在肖像摄影、虚拟现实和增强现实等应用中非常重要，但现有方法往往依赖昂贵且规模有限的光场采集数据进行监督，或难以同时满足照片级真实感、实时渲染和对未见主体的泛化能力；基于生成式NeRF的方法还常存在3D一致性不足和渲染速度较慢的问题。
AI.method: 作者利用生成式3D高斯技术，设计一种统一的神经辐射传输光照模型，使模型对入射光具有线性响应，并仅基于野外人像数据进行训练。该方法结合3D高斯表示与可分解光照建模，以实现人像的外观、几何和光照的联合表示，从而支持重光照与新视角合成。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在仅使用野外图像的设定下达到了最先进的重光照效果，同时相比此前3D感知人像重光照研究具有显著更快的渲染速度，约为12倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了生成式3D高斯结合统一神经辐射传输表示在人像重光照任务中的有效性，为实时、可泛化、无需昂贵光场采集数据的高质量3D人像重光照提供了可行路径。

title: Refining Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation via Regional Semantics and Visual Prototypes
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has shown superior performance in the image-level open-vocabulary classification task, benefiting from its powerful alignment of visual features and text embeddings. However, dense prediction tasks require models to perform pixel-level predictions, necessitating modifications to CLIP for region-text alignment. In this paper, we adjust the attention layers within the vanilla visual encoder of CLIP. With a novel attention calculation method for selective attention features, the model retains more regional semantic information. To further mitigate the negative impact of the modality gap, we introduce additional visual prototypes to refine the original predictor solely based on text embeddings. Specifically, patch features with confident predictions are selected to form an additional auxiliary memory-based classifier for more accurate prediction. We further integrate an optimizable feature extractor with an exponential moving average updating strategy to enhance prediction quality. Extensive experiments on $5$ semantic segmentation datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向密集预测任务的CLIP适配方法，通过修改视觉编码器注意力机制以保留区域语义，并引入视觉原型与记忆式辅助分类器来缓解模态间隙，在多个语义分割数据集上取得有效性验证。
AI.motivation: CLIP在图像级开放词汇分类中表现优异，得益于视觉特征与文本嵌入的对齐；但语义分割等密集预测任务要求像素级或区域级预测，需要CLIP具备区域与文本的细粒度对齐能力。直接迁移CLIP会受限于视觉编码器缺乏区域语义建模、以及视觉特征与文本嵌入之间模态间隙的影响。
AI.method: 1. 调整CLIP原始视觉编码器中的注意力层，采用新的注意力计算方式生成选择性注意特征，使模型保留更多区域级语义信息。2. 为缓解模态间隙，在仅依赖文本嵌入的原始预测器基础上引入额外视觉原型。3. 从具有置信预测结果的patch特征中构建辅助记忆式分类器，以提升预测准确性。4. 进一步设计可优化特征提取器，并采用指数滑动平均更新策略增强预测质量。
AI.result: 在5个语义分割数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法相比原始CLIP具有更好的密集预测适配能力与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明，通过选择性注意力特征、视觉原型、辅助记忆分类器以及EMA优化特征提取器，可以有效将CLIP从图像级匹配模型适配到区域/像素级开放词汇语义分割任务，并缓解模态间隙问题。

title: FedBST: Bilateral Self-Training for Unsupervised Federated Classification
summary: Unsupervised federated learning with Vision-Language Models (e.g., CLIP) offers a promising solution for label-free classification, yet its performance often degrades under severe non-IID shifts. A pioneering method, FedCoPL, typically relies on self-training strategies that exclusively prioritize high-confidence predictions for pseudo-labeling. However, this selective approach neglects the information of ambiguous samples (often referred to as ``waist" samples), leading to the underutilization of data and biased decision boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose FedBST, a bilateral self-training framework that effectively exploits both high-confidence and ambiguous data. Specifically, for local optimization, we introduce uncertainty-aware confidence penalization (UACP). UACP targets ambiguous samples by penalizing overconfident predictions to implicitly promote higher uncertainty, thereby preventing erroneous pseudo-labeling. At inference, we employ a visual-text ensemble strategy. This approach aggregates uncertainty-aware local visual prototypes and ensembles them with textual prototypes, achieving lightweight adaptation to local distributions via prototype-based calibration. Experiments demonstrate that FedBST achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with standard federated aggregation protocols.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出FedBST，一种面向联邦视觉-语言模型的双边自训练框架，同时利用高置信样本与模糊“腰部”样本，并结合不确定性感知的置信度惩罚和视觉-文本原型集成，以提升非IID场景下的无标签分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦无监督学习中的自训练方法通常只选择高置信预测生成伪标签，忽略了大量模糊样本的信息，导致数据利用不足和决策边界偏置，尤其在严重非IID数据分布下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出双边自训练框架FedBST。局部优化阶段引入不确定性感知置信度惩罚UACP，针对模糊样本抑制过自信预测，隐式促进不确定性估计，从而降低错误伪标签传播的风险。推理阶段采用视觉-文本集成策略，聚合具有不确定性感知的局部视觉原型，并与文本原型进行集成，实现基于原型校准的轻量级本地分布适配。
AI.result: 实验表明，在标准联邦聚合协议下，FedBST相比现有方法能够持续取得性能提升，说明其能更有效利用无标签数据和模糊样本，缓解非IID分布带来的退化。
AI.conclusion: FedBST通过同时利用高置信样本与模糊样本，并在推理阶段融合视觉原型与文本原型，提升了联邦视觉-语言模型在无监督非IID场景下的分类鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: CODI: Improving Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Cross Distillation
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers learn strong image-level representations, but their patch-level representations can be unreliable for dense prediction. We study this mismatch and find that the class token concentrates global semantics on a small number of representative patches, while dense prediction errors often occur on low-attention regions. We provide a local gradient analysis showing that, along the [CLS] attention readout, image-level self-distillation gradients are weighted by [CLS]-to-patch attention mass. To provide masked patches with global semantics without changing the architecture, we propose Cross Distillation (CODI), which mixes a small amount of the teacher class-token distribution into each teacher patch-token target. CODI gives every masked patch an attention-independent semantic correction while preserving the standard self-distillation architecture. Experiments on dense and image-level benchmarks show that CODI improves both dense and image-level performance under aligned pretraining settings. Code is available at https://github.com/EldercatSAM/CODI.

AI.tldr: 论文发现自监督Vision Transformer中图像级表征与patch级稠密预测表征存在不匹配：[CLS] token将全局语义集中在少数高注意力patch上，而稠密预测误差常出现在低注意力区域；提出Cross Distillation（CODI），将少量教师类token分布混合到每个教师patch-token目标中，以架构不变的方式为所有masked patch提供全局语义校正，从而同时提升稠密预测和图像级性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督ViT能学习较强的图像级表征，但其patch-level表征在语义分割等稠密预测任务上可能不可靠。作者希望解释这一图像级与patch级表征之间的失配现象，并在不改变标准自监督蒸馏架构的前提下，缓解低注意力patch缺少全局语义导致预测错误的问题。
AI.method: 论文首先分析自监督ViT中的表示失配，发现类token通过注意力将全局语义集中到少量代表性patch上，且稠密预测误差主要发生在低注意力区域；进一步通过局部梯度分析指出，在沿[CLS]注意力读取的图像级自蒸馏过程中，梯度会被[CLS]到patch的注意力权重所加权。针对这一问题，作者提出Cross Distillation（CODI），将少量教师class-token分布混合进每个教师patch-token目标中，使每个masked patch都能获得与注意力无关的全局语义校正，同时保持标准自蒸馏架构不变。
AI.result: 在稠密预测基准和图像级基准上的实验表明，CODI在一致的预训练设置下同时提升了稠密预测和图像级分类性能，说明该跨蒸馏策略能够改善ViT中patch级表征的全局语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 自监督ViT的图像级与patch级表征失配主要源于[CLS]注意力驱动的全局语义集中，导致低注意力patch难以获得充分的全局信息。CODI通过将教师类token语义引入patch-token蒸馏目标，以低成本方式校正masked patch的语义，为提升自监督ViT的稠密预测能力提供了有效且架构兼容的方法。

title: Asking Less, Adapting Better: Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions and navigate to target locations. However, current VLN agents often suffer severe performance degradation in unseen environments due to distribution shifts. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm to bridge this gap, yet existing methods that rely on unsupervised entropy minimization can propagate errors through the trajectory, causing cascading failures in navigation. Recent methods mitigate this by incorporating human feedback, but they apply trajectory-level supervision uniformly across all steps without localizing the actions is truly informative, leading to inefficient feedback utilization and mismatched optimization granularity. To address these limitations, we propose FETA, a Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation method that improves both feedback efficiency and optimization reliability. To reduce unnecessary human interventions, we introduce a hierarchical sample selection strategy to localize informative samples. Specifically, we first filter trajectories whose normalized policy entropy exhibits large fluctuations. Within each selected trajectory, we further select the critical action via an entropy-gradient saliency criterion and query a single binary feedback on its correctness. A discrepancy-aware entropy optimization objective then updates the policy only at the queried step, with adaptive scaling that assigns larger relative weights to samples with greater prediction-feedback discrepancy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FETA achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer human interventions, while remaining robust under noisy feedback and continual adaptation settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FETA：一种反馈高效的测试时自适应方法，用于视觉-语言导航中通过层级样本选择和偏差感知熵优化，减少人类反馈需求并提升未见环境鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLN 测试时自适应方法多依赖无监督熵最小化，容易沿轨迹传播错误并导致级联失败；引入人类反馈的已有方法通常对轨迹级监督进行均匀分配，无法定位真正有信息量的动作，造成反馈利用率低和优化粒度不匹配。
AI.method: 提出 FETA，包含层级样本选择与反馈高效优化策略。首先筛选归一化策略熵波动较大的轨迹；在轨迹内通过熵梯度显著性准则选择关键动作，并仅查询该动作正确性的单一二元反馈。随后使用偏差感知熵优化目标，仅在查询步骤更新策略，并根据预测与反馈偏差自适应缩放，使更大偏差获得更高优化权重。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，FETA 以更少的人类干预取得先进性能，同时在噪声反馈和持续自适应设置下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FETA 通过定位信息丰富样本和精细化反馈优化粒度，提升了视觉-语言导航测试时自适应中的反馈效率与优化可靠性，是一种更有效、更鲁棒的 VLN 自适应方法。

title: One-shot federated unsupervised domain adaptation with Smoothed Knowledge Distillation and teacher refinement
comment: Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Vol. 167, 113946 (2026). DOI: 10.1016/j.engappai.2026.113946. Available at: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0952197626002277 and Code is available at: https://github.com/A-Abedi/SKD_ETR
summary: Federated unsupervised domain adaptation (FUDA) addresses the challenge of adapting models to an unlabeled target domain using decentralized source domains while preserving data privacy. However, existing FUDA methods typically require multiple communication rounds, rely on complex aggregation strategies, and often struggle with noisy pseudo labels and inconsistent source knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose SKD-ETR, a novel one-shot FUDA framework that combines Smoothed Knowledge Distillation (SKD) and Exponential moving average-based Teacher Refinement (ETR). SKD trains a student model on the target domain using smoothed soft pseudo labels generated by the ensemble of source models. This reduces overconfidence, mitigates noise, and improves robustness. ETR further refines each source model by interpolating its parameters toward the student via exponential moving average (EMA), thereby transferring target-domain knowledge back to the teachers. This bidirectional refinement enhances pseudo-label quality and student generalization without additional communication overhead. SKD-ETR eliminates complex aggregation by initializing the student model randomly and performing a single-round distillation process. Extensive experiments on OfficeHome, Office-Caltech, and DomainNet demonstrate that SKD-ETR achieves competitive performance while being communication- and computation-efficient, and robust under noisy supervision. The code for this paper is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/SKD_ETR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKD-ETR，一种单轮联邦无监督域自适应框架，通过平滑知识蒸馏和基于EMA的教师精炼缓解伪标签噪声与源域知识不一致，并避免复杂聚合与多轮通信。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦无监督域自适应方法通常需要多轮通信、复杂聚合策略，且容易受到目标域伪标签噪声和多个源域知识不一致的影响。
AI.method: SKD-ETR包含两个核心模块：Smoothed Knowledge Distillation利用源模型集成的平滑软伪标签训练目标域学生模型，降低过度自信并提升鲁棒性；Exponential moving average-based Teacher Refinement通过EMA将学生模型参数反向插值到各源教师模型，实现目标知识回传和双向精炼，同时保持单轮蒸馏、无需复杂聚合。
AI.result: 在OfficeHome、Office-Caltech和DomainNet上的实验表明，SKD-ETR具有较强竞争力，在通信效率、计算效率和噪声伪标签鲁棒性方面表现良好。
AI.conclusion: SKD-ETR能够以更简单高效的单轮联邦蒸馏方式提升联邦无监督域自适应的性能与鲁棒性，适合隐私保护下的去中心化域适应场景。

title: Residual Calibration via Local Feature-Space Refinement
summary: Deep neural networks often struggle to provide reliable confidence estimates, making post-hoc calibration essential for reliable decision-making. Existing post-hoc methods largely rely on score-based transformations, which improve marginal calibration but often fail to capture spatially varying miscalibration in local regions of the learned feature space. To address this gap, we propose Local Adaptive Probability Estimation (LAPE), a post-hoc residual calibration framework. Specifically, LAPE treats the global calibrator output as a stable anchor and refines the individual prediction by leveraging non-parametric local evidence from neighboring calibration samples. As a plug-and-play refinement module, LAPE effectively utilizes the information about feature-space geometry and can reuse the calibration data that are used to construct the global calibrator. Furthermore, we extend LAPE to the setting with multi-view inputs through Cascade Feature Augmentation Fusion (CFAF). Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods can improve the calibration quality of various existing baselines and remain efficient and robust across different settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 LAPE（Local Adaptive Probability Estimation）这一后验残差校准框架：以全局校准器输出为稳定锚点，利用校准集中邻近样本的非参数局部证据修正个体预测概率，并通过 CFAF 扩展到多视图输入，以提升置信度可靠性。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络常给出不可靠的置信度估计；现有后验校准方法多依赖基于分数的变换，虽能改善整体/边际校准，却往往难以捕捉特征空间中局部区域差异化的校准偏差。
AI.method: LAPE 将全局校准器的输出作为锚点，在特征空间中根据邻近校准样本的局部证据进行残差修正，形成即插即用的局部自适应概率估计；同时可复用构建全局校准器所用的校准数据。针对多视图输入，进一步提出级联特征增强融合（CFAF）以扩展 LAPE。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法能够改善多种现有基线校准器的校准质量，并在不同设置下保持高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 局部非参数证据可以弥补全局分数变换式后验校准的不足，使概率校准不仅关注整体统计，也能反映特征空间局部区域的校准误差，从而提升模型置信估计的可靠性。

title: Class-Grounded Batik Captioning under Scarce Text Annotation: Label Retention and Source-Specific Error Propagation
summary: Class labels offer compact supervision for describing cultural-heritage images when expert text annotations are scarce. We investigate a batik-captioning cascade that integrates a LoRA-adapted DINOv2 classifier with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, adapted using LoRA and loaded in 4-bit NF4. A $3\times2$ evaluation combines three captioner conditions with two inference prompts to examine adaptation and predicted-class injection. Across 150 caption-evaluation images, all three injected conditions achieve a ground-truth class-label mention rate of 0.9067. The classifier's separate test yields 96.10% pooled accuracy, with 98.33% on 300 public-source images and 75.76% on 33 local images. Supported-class macro-F1 and balanced accuracy on the local subset are 0.8493 and 0.8302, respectively. The classifier and captioner use separate partitions, and their training--evaluation overlap remains unquantified. Differences in label semantics and training support also affect interpretation of the source-specific accuracy gap. Reference-based caption metrics and image--text compatibility scores produce different model rankings. Qualitative examples show both retention of correctly predicted identities and propagation of classification errors into fluent descriptions. These findings characterize how class conditioning preserves label information and transfers upstream errors into batik captions under scarce text annotation.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个用于蜡染图像描述生成的级联系统：先用 LoRA 微调的 DINOv2 分类器预测类别标签，再将该标签注入经过 LoRA 适配并采用 4-bit NF4 加载的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 生成描述，以在专家文本标注稀缺条件下利用类别标签进行紧凑监督，并分析分类误差向描述结果的传递。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产图像往往缺乏充足、专业的文本标注，而类别标签可提供低成本、高信息密度的监督信号。作者希望检验：在蜡染图像描述任务中，将上游分类器的预测类别注入下游多模态描述模型，是否有助于保留真实标签信息、提升生成可控性，以及分类误差会如何被带入最终描述。
AI.method: 提出蜡染描述级联框架：使用 LoRA 微调 DINOv2 作为类别分类器，并使用 LoRA 适配、4-bit NF4 量化加载 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 作为描述生成器。实验采用 3×2 评估设计，即三种描述模型条件与两种推理提示组合，考察适配方式和预测类别注入的影响。在 150 张用于描述评估的图像上统计真实类别标签提及率；分类器单独测试包括 300 张公开来源图像和 33 张本地图像，并报告准确率、支持类别上的宏 F1 与平衡准确率。评估指标同时包括基于参考的描述指标和图文匹配指标，并辅以定性分析。
AI.result: 在所有注入预测类别的实验条件下，真实类别标签提及率均达到 0.9067，说明类别条件化能较稳定地保留标签信息。分类器总体准确率为 96.10%，其中公开来源图像准确率为 98.33%，本地图像准确率为 75.76%；本地图像支持类别上的宏 F1 为 0.8493，平衡准确率为 0.8302。定性结果显示，系统既能保留正确预测的身份信息，也会将分类错误传递为流畅但不准确的描述。不同指标对模型排序不一致，提示评估结果依赖指标选择。作者指出分类与描述使用独立划分，但训练—评估重叠尚未量化，且标签语义和训练支持差异会影响不同来源准确率差距的解释。
AI.conclusion: 类别标签可作为专家文本标注稀缺时的高效监督与条件控制手段，能够显著促进蜡染图像描述中对正确类别信息的保留。然而，该级联系统并非可靠地消除误差：上游分类错误会被下游语言模型吸收并表达为流畅描述，尤其在本地图像上分类性能明显下降时更需警惕。不同评估指标产生不一致排序，也说明单一自动指标不足以判断生成质量。整体上，该工作揭示了“类别条件化保留标签信息”与“传递上游分类误差”之间的权衡，并强调需要更严格的训练—评估重叠检查和语义一致性分析来支持实际文化遗产应用。

title: AgentDreamer: Agentic 3D Motion Reasoning for Text-Controllable Physics Simulation
summary: We propose AgentDreamer, an agent-guided optimization framework that aligns text instructions with simulated motion through explicit 3D motion planning. Given a text instruction and scene geometry, an off-the-shelf agent translates the instruction into a structured semantic motion prior, specifying what should move, in which direction, and in what temporal order. The agent represents this prior using parametric functions over a series of temporal chunks, yielding dense 3D trajectories. We then optimize the parameters of a differentiable MPM simulator such that its rollout best matches the prior while remaining constrained by the scene dynamics. This allows the agent to provide semantic guidance from language, while the simulator grounds it in physically feasible motion. We further introduce Motion-IG, an information-theoretic metric for text-motion alignment based on masked text recovery. By comparing the likelihood of recovering masked motion-related content with and without the simulated motion, Motion-IG measures the information contributed by the motion beyond that available from the remaining text and scene context. Experiments show that AgentDreamer improves text alignment over video-based guidance, producing simulations that more closely follow the requested physical behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentDreamer，一个由智能体引导的可微物理仿真优化框架，将文本指令转化为显式3D运动先验，并通过优化MPM仿真器参数实现语义与物理一致的文本可控运动模拟；同时提出Motion-IG指标衡量文本与模拟运动之间的对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导物理模拟或视频生成方法中，语言指令往往难以被精确转化为符合场景动力学、空间结构和时间顺序的真实运动行为。作者希望利用智能体的语义规划能力，将自然语言指令解耦为显式的“什么物体移动、往哪个方向、按什么时间顺序移动”的结构化运动先验，再让可微物理仿真器在该先验与场景约束之间优化出既可控又物理可行的运动结果。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个核心部分。首先，给定文本指令和场景几何，使用现成智能体将自然语言转化为结构化语义运动先验；该先验以参数化函数表示在一系列时间块上，并生成密集的3D运动轨迹。其次，利用可微材料点法（MPM）仿真器，优化其参数，使仿真结果尽可能匹配智能体给出的运动先验，同时受到场景动力学和物理约束。此外，提出信息论指标Motion-IG，通过掩码文本恢复来度量模拟运动相对于剩余文本和场景上下文所额外提供的信息，从而评估文本与运动之间的对齐质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，AgentDreamer在文本对齐方面优于基于视频引导的方法，其生成的模拟结果更符合用户请求的物理行为，说明显式3D运动规划与可微物理仿真相结合能够提升文本可控模拟的语义准确性与物理一致性。
AI.conclusion: AgentDreamer通过智能体提供高层语义指导、可微物理仿真器提供低层物理约束，实现了对文本指令到3D运动的可控映射。提出的Motion-IG指标也为评估文本与模拟运动之间的一致性提供了新的度量方式。该工作展示了将语言规划、显式运动建模和物理仿真结合用于生成可解释、可控制的物理模拟场景的可行性。

title: Zero-Shot Domain Generalization via Domain Prompt Learning
summary:
Domain generalization (DG) aims to improve
  the generalization of the model to any unseen domains. Targeting this goal, existing DG methods mainly focus on learning domain-invariant features or prompts from the given source domains. However, these methods rely on source-domain data, and collecting and annotating large-scale single- or multi-source datasets is often infeasible, limiting the practical applicability of DG. To tackle this challenge, we propose {\underline{Do}}main \underline{P}rompt Learning (DoP), a method built on a large vision-language model (e.g., CLIP) for zero-shot domain generalization, which recognizes unseen classes in unseen target domains without access to source-domain data. DoP essentially learns the target domain knowledge via prompt both in text and visual modalities to overcome the domain shift in text-visual modalities under the test-time adaptation formulation. Specifically, DoP first takes text domain learning (TDL) to simulate various distribution shifts by learning diverse style tokens implicitly in the text space with inter-style diversity loss and intra-style consistency loss. Subsequently, DoP employs visual domain learning (VDL) to further refine the target-domain-relevant style token generated by TDL by making use of the test visual data with self-supervised learning. Extensive experiments on popular DG benchmark datasets (e.g., PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet) and ImageNet show that our DoP consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art DG approaches. Codes are available at: https://github.com/shiming-chen/DoP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoP（Domain Prompt Learning），一种基于大型视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的零样本域泛化方法，通过在文本和视觉模态中学习域提示来识别未见域中的未见类别，无需访问源域数据。
AI.motivation: 现有域泛化方法通常依赖源域数据来学习域不变特征或提示，但大规模单源或多源数据的收集和标注往往不可行，限制了方法的实际适用性；因此需要在不依赖源域数据的情况下，使模型能够适应未见目标域。
AI.method: DoP首先采用文本域学习（TDL），在文本空间中隐式学习多种风格提示，并通过跨风格多样性损失和风格内一致性损失来模拟多种分布偏移；随后采用视觉域学习（VDL），利用测试视觉数据通过自监督学习进一步精炼与目标域相关、由TDL生成的风格提示，以在测试时适应（test-time adaptation）框架下缓解文本—视觉模态间的域偏移。
AI.result: 在PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome、DomainNet和ImageNet等主流域泛化基准数据集上，DoP持续优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DoP证明了在无需源域数据的情况下，通过学习文本和视觉模态中的域提示，并结合测试时适应，可以显著提升模型在未见域和未见类别上的零样本域泛化能力。

title: LoRA Superposition across Pretrained Models
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is usually tied to the pretrained backbone on which it is learned. We ask whether LoRAs trained independently for the same task on different pretrained backbones can be summed and applied unchanged to all contributing backbones. We call this construction LoRA superposition. Across seven ViT-B/16 CLIP backbones and eight image-classification tasks, the exact sum improves all 56 backbone-task pairs and achieves a mean accuracy gain of 30.21 percentage points over the unadapted backbone. The exact sum achieves a mean accuracy only 0.28 percentage points below that of individually trained solo LoRAs. In contrast, a leave-one-model-out (LOMO) sum produces a mean gain of only 0.06 percentage points over the unadapted backbones. Backbone-specific solo LoRAs are nearly orthogonal in parameter space, while pairwise cross-backbone responses are strongly concentrated on the diagonal. These results support a component-wise non-interference hypothesis, under which the frozen backbone acts as an implicit selector of its own component without explicit routing or cross-model alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“LoRA superposition”：将在不同预训练 backbone 上独立训练的 LoRA 直接相加并复用到各个 backbone 上，结果几乎等同于单独训练的 LoRA，说明 LoRA 模块之间存在可叠加性且 backbone 可隐式选择自身组件。
AI.motivation: 现有 LoRA 通常与特定预训练 backbone 绑定。研究问题为：针对同一任务、在不同 backbone 上独立训练的 LoRA 能否直接求和，并以未修改形式应用回所有相关 backbone，从而实现跨模型的轻量适配器复用与组合。
AI.method: 以 ViT-B/16 CLIP 为实验基础，选取 7 个 backbone 和 8 个图像分类任务。将每个 backbone-task 独立训练得到的 LoRA 进行精确求和，构造 LoRA superposition，并直接应用到各 backbone。进一步与 leave-one-model-out（LOMO）求和、solo LoRA 基线比较，同时分析参数空间中 solo LoRA 的正交性以及跨 backbone 响应的对角集中现象。
AI.result: 在全部 56 个 backbone-task 组合中，精确求和均带来改进，相比未适配 backbone 的平均准确率提升 30.21 个百分点；与单独训练的 solo LoRA 相比，仅平均低 0.28 个百分点。相反，LOMO 求和相比未适配 backbone 仅提升 0.06 个百分点。参数分析表明 backbone 专属 solo LoRA 近似正交，且跨 backbone 响应高度集中在对角线上。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持“component-wise non-interference”假设：当 LoRA 分别针对各自 backbone 训练时，它们在参数空间中接近互不干扰，因此可直接叠加使用；冻结的 backbone 本身起到隐式选择器作用，无需显式路由或跨模型对齐。这为 LoRA 的模块化组合和跨 backbone 复用提供了理论依据与实证支持。

title: ParaLin++: Accelerating Parallel Diffusion Integrator via Intrinsic Partially Linear Structure
summary:
Training-free few-step samplers are often described as nearly quality-lossless under conventional FID/CLIP-style evaluation. It remains unclear whether that conclusion transfers to more realistic and complex generation-quality benchmarks. We first systematize the quality metrics used to evaluate training-free sampling acceleration for diffusion and flow-matching models.
  We find that representative training-free step-shortening methods often remain nearly lossless under FID/CLIP-class metrics, yet can suffer substantial quality degradation when evaluated with semantic-composition, dense-instruction, and long-text-rendering benchmarks such as GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench. Parallel sampling is a notable exception: by retaining the full-step discretization and removing only the solver's temporal dependency, it can preserve near-lossless quality while accelerating sampling. Building on this observation, we propose \textit{ParaLin++}, a step-parity parallel sampler that preserves the full-step discretization while accelerating the solver iterations. Experiments across Stable Diffusion-v2, LSUN Church, FLUX.1-dev, and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 show that ParaLin++ preserves the full-step Euler quality profile at $2.6\times$--$4.8\times$, $1.68\times$ on FLUX, and $1.21\times$ on Ming. Project page: https://paralinplus.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 论文指出：仅依赖 FID/CLIP 类指标会低估训练无关少步采样器的质量退化，并提出 ParaLin++，通过保留全步离散化、加速求解器迭代实现更可靠的快速采样。
AI.motivation: 现有训练无关少步采样器在 FID/CLIP 等传统评测下常被认为近乎无损，但在更复杂、更贴近实际使用场景的生成质量基准上是否仍成立尚不清楚。
AI.method: 作者首先系统化梳理扩散与流匹配模型中训练无关采样加速的评测指标；随后分析代表性方法，并基于并行采样可保留完整步长离散化、仅移除求解器时间依赖的发现，提出 step-parity 并行采样器 ParaLin++，在保持全步 Euler 离散化的同时加速 solver 迭代。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion-v2、LSUN Church、FLUX.1-dev 和 Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 上，ParaLin++ 可保持全步 Euler 的质量表现，并分别实现约 2.6–4.8 倍、1.68 倍和 1.21 倍加速；同时实验显示多数少步方法在 GenEval、DPG-Bench、LongTextBench 等复杂语义/指令/长文本渲染基准上存在明显质量下降。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关少步采样器并非在所有真实复杂评测下都近无损；保留完整步长离散化并解除求解器时序依赖，是实现高质量加速采样的更可靠路径。

title: PhyEvolve: Multi-Agent State-Evolution Planning for Physics-Aware Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have substantially improved visual fidelity, yet existing models still struggle to understand the physical evolution implicit in user prompts, making it difficult to generate videos with continuous physical state evolution. Here, we propose PhyEvolve, a multi-agent framework that enhances natural-language prompts through structured state-evolution planning. PhyEvolve consists of three agents: a Director, a Physical Evolver, and a Composer. Given a user prompt and an optional first frame, the Director grounds the scene and disentangles physical events from observation changes. The Physical Evolver uses scene evidence to identify physical mechanisms then constructs causally linked state transitions that unfold throughout the video, whether visible or not. The Composer utilizes these transitions to enhance the original prompts. Without retraining or model modification, PhyEvolve works directly with existing generators through prompt replacement. Extensive experiments on four major benchmarks show that PhyEvolve achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the cutting-edge prior agentic baseline by 7.9 percentage points on average. These results demonstrate that explicit causal state-evolution planning improves physical consistency and state continuity in generated videos through natural-language prompt enhancement.

AI.tldr: PhyEvolve是一种多智能体框架，通过显式的因果状态演化规划来增强文本到视频生成中的自然语言提示，从而提升生成视频中物理状态演化的连续性和一致性，无需修改或重新训练现有视频生成模型即可达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到视频生成模型虽然在视觉保真度上已有显著提升，但仍难以理解用户提示中隐含的物理演化过程，导致生成的视频缺乏连续的物理状态演变，物理一致性不足。现有方法无法有效建模视频中物体随时间的因果状态变化。
AI.method: 提出PhyEvolve，一个由三个智能体组成的多智能体框架，用于增强自然语言提示中的结构化状态演化规划：（1）Director：给定用户提示和可选首帧，对场景进行落地理解，将物理事件与观察变化解耦；（2）Physical Evolver：利用场景证据识别物理机制，构建在视频中展开的因果关联状态转移序列（无论可见与否）；（3）Composer：利用这些状态转移序列增强原始提示。整个流程通过提示替换直接与现有视频生成器配合工作，无需重训或修改模型。
AI.result: 在四个主要基准上的大量实验表明，PhyEvolve达到了最先进的性能，相较于前沿的基于智能体的基线方法平均提升7.9个百分点，证明了显式因果状态演化规划能够通过自然语言提示增强提升生成视频的物理一致性和状态连续性。
AI.conclusion: 显式的因果状态演化规划是提升文本到视频生成中物理一致性的有效途径。PhyEvolve通过多智能体协作将物理推理转化为语言层面的提示增强，无需修改底层生成模型即可实现即插即用的性能提升，为物理感知的视频生成提供了新的研究思路。

title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual Representation Learning
summary: Video provides a natural source of supervision: what happens next serves as a learning signal for visual world modeling. Yet masked video pretraining focuses on recovering missing content from surrounding context rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive methods instead predict forward one token at a time, but have yet to match joint-embedding methods in representation quality. This gap motivates us to revisit the granularity and space of future prediction. In this work, we introduce VANE, a self-supervised visual pretraining framework built on next-frame prediction in embedding space. A causal encoder summarizes past observations for a state predictor that infers the representation of the entire next frame, making temporal evolution the primary learning signal. This prediction is carried out in a fixed embedding space provided by a frozen semantic tokenizer, emphasizing scene content and structure. To retain fine-grained spatial detail alongside semantic content, a lightweight auxiliary generative decoder reconstructs future-frame patches conditioned on the predicted representations. To unify visual modeling across images and videos, we construct a local-to-global crop sequence for still images, allowing the same encoder to predict newly revealed regions from earlier crops under the same objective. Experiments show that VANE improves with model and data scaling, achieving SOTA on most anticipation, recognition, and dense perception benchmarks among unified encoders. Especially on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 action anticipation, it surpasses V-JEPA 2.1 by 7.1 points in mean-class recall@5. These results demonstrate that next-frame prediction in embedding space is effective and scalable for visual world modeling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VANE，一种在嵌入空间中基于下一帧预测的自监督视觉预训练框架，通过因果编码器、状态预测器和冻结语义分词器实现可扩展的视觉世界建模。
AI.motivation: 掩码视频预训练主要恢复缺失内容，而非从过去预测未来；自回归方法面向未来预测，但表征质量通常不及联合嵌入方法。因此，需要重新思考未来预测的粒度和空间，以提升视频视觉表征质量和动作预期能力。
AI.method: VANE使用因果编码器总结过去观测，状态预测器推断整个下一帧的表征，并将预测置于冻结语义分词器提供的固定嵌入空间中以强调场景内容与结构。为保留细粒度空间细节，引入轻量辅助生成解码器，在预测表征条件下重建未来帧patch。对静态图像构建局部到全局裁剪序列，使同一编码器能在相同目标下预测新揭示区域，从而统一图像与视频视觉建模。
AI.result: 实验表明VANE随模型和数据规模扩展而提升，并在多数动作预期、识别和密集感知基准上取得统一编码器中的SOTA结果。特别是在EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作预期任务上，其mean-class recall@5超过V-JEPA 2.1达7.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在嵌入空间中进行下一帧预测是有效且可扩展的视觉世界建模方式，能够同时提升未来预测能力、语义表征质量和细粒度空间建模能力。

title: SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables; conference paper prepared for IROS2027
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in multi-task robotic manipulation by leveraging visual and language understanding for action generation. However, existing lightweight VLA models employ a single dense action expert to handle all tasks, which limits their multi-task capability under constrained computational budgets. To address this issue, we propose SmolVLA-MoE, a novel framework that introduces sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) into the FFN layers of the action expert in VLA models. SmolVLA-MoE replaces dense FFN layers with multiple parallel expert FFNs and a token-level router, enabling each token to adaptively select the most suitable expert for action generation. We further introduce a shared expert with a tunable weight parameter to balance the inheritance of pre-trained capabilities and task-specific expert specialization. Through sparse activation, SmolVLA-MoE activates only a single expert FFN during inference, with a total activated parameter count of approximately 500M including the frozen VLM backbone, while benefiting from approximately 800M total stored parameters. We evaluate our method on four task suites of the LIBERO benchmark. SmolVLA-MoE achieves an average success rate of 84.25%, outperforming SmolVLA (82.75%) and OpenVLA-7B (76.5%), while maintaining comparable inference efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SmolVLA-MoE，将稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）引入视觉—语言—动作模型的轻量动作专家 FFN 层，在有限激活参数预算下提升多任务机器人操作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量 VLA 模型通常使用单一稠密动作专家处理所有任务，在计算资源受限情况下容易限制多任务能力；作者希望在保持推理效率的同时增强模型对不同动作任务的适应能力。
AI.method: 方法将稠密 FFN 替换为多个并行专家 FFN，并加入 token-level router，使每个 token 自适应选择最适合动作生成的专家；同时引入带可调权重的共享专家，以平衡预训练能力继承与任务特定专家专业化。推理时仅激活单个专家 FFN，总激活参数约 500M，包含冻结的 VLM 主干，同时存储参数约 800M。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 基准的四个任务集上，SmolVLA-MoE 平均成功率为 84.25%，优于 SmolVLA 的 82.75% 和 OpenVLA-7B 的 76.5%，并保持相近的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏 MoE 设计能够在不显著增加推理开销的前提下提升轻量 VLA 模型的多任务机器人操作性能，说明专家选择机制对动作建模具有有效性；代码已开源。

title: Where Did the Light Come From? Diagnosing Cast-Shadow Reasoning in VLMs and Borrowing the Missing Shadow Prior from Image Generation Models
summary: Shadows are observable consequences of latent physical causes, arising from the interaction between illumination, object geometry, and scene structure. A model that understands shadows should be able not only to read a shadow's direction, but also to infer where a shadow should fall when it is absent, and to judge whether a shadow is physically consistent with the scene. We introduce ShadowBench, built from real photographs, which poses these three questions to vision-language models (VLMs). From each scene, we build a correct-shadow, a shadow-removed, and a human-annotated wrong-direction state. Evaluating 19 open VLMs (2B to 78B) and frontier proprietary models, we find that VLMs read a visible shadow's direction well above chance and improve with scale, yet infer the absent direction only weakly and fall to chance at judging physical consistency even under a bias-free two-alternative test that removes the yes-bias of single-image naturalness questions. Only Gemini-3.1-pro exceeds chance on validity, and even then only modestly and far below humans. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) does not help. The missing ingredient is not reasoning but knowledge that image generation models (IGMs) already hold. Routing a VLM through an IGM lifts its inference well above its direct attempt and helps it flag the wrong-direction shadows it otherwise accepts. Cast-shadow direction is a single facet of illumination understanding, but the sharp gap it reveals between VLMs and IGMs suggests image-generation or reconstruction objectives as a route toward illumination-aware VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShadowBench，基于真实照片评估视觉语言模型对阴影的三种理解能力：读取可见阴影方向、推断缺失阴影应落位置、判断阴影是否与场景物理一致。研究发现VLM能较好识别可见阴影方向，但推断缺失方向弱，物理一致性判断接近随机；而通过图像生成模型可显著改善其阴影推断能力。
AI.motivation: 阴影是光照、物体几何和场景结构交互产生的可观察结果，反映模型是否真正理解场景中的物理因果关系。现有视觉语言模型可能只是读取表面视觉线索，而无法在阴影缺失或错误时进行推断与物理一致性判断。因此，需要专门基准检验模型对阴影的深层理解。
AI.method: 作者从真实照片中构建ShadowBench，为每个场景准备三种状态：正确阴影、移除阴影、人工标注的错误方向阴影。基准分别询问模型阴影方向、缺失阴影应出现的位置、以及阴影是否符合场景物理规律。论文评估了19个开源视觉语言模型（参数量2B至78B）以及前沿闭源模型，并检验思维链提示是否有帮助，以及将视觉语言模型路由到图像生成模型是否能提升性能。
AI.result: 视觉语言模型在读取可见阴影方向上显著高于随机水平，并随模型规模提升而改善；但在推断缺失阴影方向时表现较弱，在判断阴影物理一致性时接近随机水平。即使采用去除“yes偏差”的双选项无偏测试，结果仍如此。只有Gemini-3.1-pro在有效性判断上略高于随机，但远低于人类。思维链提示未带来明显帮助。引入图像生成模型后，视觉语言模型的缺失阴影推断能力明显提升，并能更好地发现原本接受的错误方向阴影。
AI.conclusion: 阴影方向理解暴露了视觉语言模型与图像生成模型之间在场景物理和光照知识上的显著差距。VLM的不足可能不在显式推理，而在缺乏图像生成模型所具备的生成或重建先验知识。该结果提示，引入图像生成或重建目标可能是提升视觉语言模型光照理解和物理一致性推理能力的重要路径。

title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
summary: Complex camera motion is central to visual storytelling, yet translating cinematographic intent into controllable, executable camera trajectories remains challenging. We introduce FilmFlow, an agentic framework that converts natural-language instructions or reference videos into explicit camera trajectories for dynamic 3D environments. To generate these trajectories, a Director agent constructs executable camera plans by composing high-level motions from concurrent atomic operations that jointly control translation, rotation, and framing. The Director is supported by three specialized agents: an Interpreter that extracts scene-grounded cinematographic intent, a Scout that selects initial viewpoints, and a Critic that evaluates rendered results and provides visual feedback for iterative plan refinement. We also introduce CinemaBench, comprising 150 Blender scenes from self-created and licensed sources, with five camera instructions per scene for 750 text-directed tasks and 60 reference videos associated with a subset of scenes. CinemaBench supports evaluation of both text-directed camera generation and video reference-directed camera generation. Across a diverse set of evaluated baselines, FilmFlow achieves the strongest benchmark performance and the highest user preference, demonstrating effective spatial reasoning, temporal coordination, and visual composition for executable 3D cinematography.

AI.tldr: FilmFlow 是一个面向复杂相机运动的智能体框架，可将自然语言指令或参考视频转换为可执行的 3D 相机轨迹，并提出 CinemaBench 用于评测文本导向和视频导向的相机生成。
AI.motivation: 复杂相机运动对视觉叙事至关重要，但将电影化意图转化为可控、可执行的相机轨迹仍具挑战。现有方法难以同时处理空间关系、时间协调和画面构图，因此需要一种能够理解指令或视频、生成精确轨迹并进行迭代优化的框架。
AI.method: 作者提出 FilmFlow，采用多智能体架构生成显式相机轨迹。Director 智能体负责制定可执行相机计划，并通过并发原子操作联合控制平移、旋转和取景。Interpreter 从文本或参考视频中提取场景相关的电影化意图；Scout 选择初始视点；Critic 根据渲染结果提供视觉反馈，迭代改进计划。同时提出 CinemaBench，包含 150 个 Blender 场景、750 个文本导向相机指令任务，以及 60 个参考视频任务，用于评估两类相机轨迹生成方法。
AI.result: 在多个基线方法上，FilmFlow 在 CinemaBench 中取得了最强基准表现，并在用户偏好评测中获得最高满意度。实验表明该方法在空间推理、时间协调和视觉构图方面具有优势，能够生成更符合指令或参考视频的可执行 3D 相机轨迹。
AI.conclusion: FilmFlow 验证了智能体协作框架在电影级相机运动生成中的有效性，能够把抽象视觉意图转化为可控、可执行的动态 3D 相机轨迹。CinemaBench 为该任务提供了更全面的评测基础，推动文本和视频驱动的相机规划研究发展。

title: Evaluation of Front-End Feature Matching for Lunar Visual SLAM
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE Aerospace Conference
summary: Lunar rovers will primarily rely on cameras for localization until navigation satellite services are deployed, and will continue to need them afterwards for relative navigation, hazard detection, and surface operations. Visual odometry (VO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) mostly estimate motion by matching features between frames. However, feature matchers are developed on urban, indoor and driving scenes, planetary studies compare them on orbital registration or within complete SLAM systems, and real lunar imagery with reference poses is scarce, so matching between rover frames on low-texture, harshly lit terrain, and its effect on VO, has not been compared. We benchmark eleven classical and learned detector-matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed, and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a feature tracker, scoring pairwise pose accuracy against baseline and the trajectory error of the resulting VO. Under a common rotation-only metric, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT with ratio-tested FLANN matching on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site, with smaller or unresolved differences on synthetic data. When rotation and translation direction are scored jointly, this SIFT pairing exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, so synthetic results alone do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery. In stereo VO, the SuperPoint pairings are not consistently more accurate than SIFT, but only they keep tracking on all eight sequential datasets. Pairings with classical detectors depend on lighting while SuperPoint changes little: a low spotlight makes them more accurate than diffuse light on the same testbed views, consistent with more contrast and detected keypoints. SuperPoint with LightGlue is the fastest learned combination (16 ms per frame), and DINOv2 retrieval proposals still need geometric verification.

AI.tldr: 论文针对月球车视觉里程计场景，系统评测了11种经典与学习型特征检测-匹配器组合在合成、月面试验台和地球类比图像上的位姿估计与跟踪表现，发现学习型SuperPoint组合在真实/试验台场景中更具跟踪鲁棒性，但合成数据不能可靠外推月面性能。
AI.motivation: 月球车在导航卫星服务部署前主要依赖相机定位，后续仍需视觉系统用于相对导航、危险检测与月面操作。现有视觉特征匹配器主要在城市场景、室内场景或驾驶场景中开发评测，真实月面影像又常缺乏参考位姿，导致低纹理、强明暗变化月面条件下不同匹配器对视觉里程计（VO）和SLAM性能的影响尚未被系统比较。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个面向月球车视觉定位的基准评测，比较11种经典与学习型检测-匹配器组合以及一个特征跟踪器；在9个数据集上进行实验，包括合成数据、月面试验台数据和地球类比场地数据；评测指标包括帧间相对位姿精度、统一旋转度量、旋转与平移方向联合度量，以及基于这些匹配结果构建的VO轨迹误差；同时分析光照条件、立体VO跟踪连续性、推理速度和检索匹配方案。
AI.result: 在仅使用旋转误差度量时，SuperPoint相关配对在两个月面试验台数据集和一个类比场地上优于SIFT搭配比例测试FLANN匹配；但在合成数据上，若联合评价旋转和平移方向，SIFT配对在四个合成数据集上超过SuperPoint配对，说明合成基准不能单独证明真实月面性能。立体VO中，SuperPoint配对并不总是比SIFT更准确，但只有它们在全部8个连续数据集上保持跟踪。经典检测器配对对光照条件敏感，低聚光灯下反而因对比度更高、关键点更多而提升精度；而SuperPoint受光照变化影响较小。速度方面，SuperPoint搭配LightGlue是16 ms/帧的最快学习型组合；DINOv2检索候选仍需要几何验证。
AI.conclusion: 学习型SuperPoint组合在月面试验台和类比场景下表现出更强的持续跟踪能力，并对苛刻光照更具鲁棒性，适合用于低纹理、明暗剧烈的月面视觉里程计；但合成数据不能可靠预测真实月面相对性能，月球车视觉定位方案需要结合真实月面或高保真月面测试数据、旋转与平移联合指标以及多光照条件进行综合验证。

title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
summary:
Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit, a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history.
  Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27-40% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU+ by 47% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57x speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DeXplicit，一种面向灵巧操作的世界模型，先在度量三维空间中显式预测物体运动与形变，再以此为条件生成未来视频，从而提升动力学预测精度和渲染效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型往往将动作条件动力学、相机运动和视觉合成耦合在一起，或仅用点轨迹表示动力学而缺乏显式物体结构，导致预测不够几何一致、渲染负担重且生成效率低。
AI.method: 给定初始场景和未来手部轨迹，DeXplicit 使用轻量三维动力学网络显式预测以物体为中心的运动与形变，得到几何可落地的未来三维状态；随后通过三维运动传送外观并投影到未来视角，使渲染器只需补全不确定和新可见内容。该“先显式三维、后生成视频”的设计还支持以每块两步去噪的高效因果生成。
AI.result: 在 HOT3D、OakInk2 和 PhysTwin 上，相比 PointWorld，DeXplicit 将移动点误差降低 27%-40%；在共享渲染器下，HOT3D 上的物体保真度 IoU+ 提升 47%；其两步因果生成相比 14B 双向视频合成配置实现 57 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 将灵巧操作世界建模拆解为显式三维动力学预测和外观补全式渲染，比端到端视频生成或纯点轨迹表示更能兼顾几何准确、物体一致性与生成效率。

title: WovenAnchor Matcher: Specialized Intra- and Inter-Image Context Modeling for Feature Matching
summary: Semi-dense local feature matching commonly aggregates contextual information before coarse-to-fine correspondence estimation. However, intra-image and inter-image aggregation serve different roles: the former should propagate spatial evidence within each image while retaining structured two-dimensional dependencies, whereas the latter should gather information from plausible corresponding regions while limiting noise from unrelated locations. We propose WovenAnchor Matcher (WAM), a semi-dense matching framework based on role-specialized context aggregation. WAM introduces two complementary operators. WovenMamba performs intra-image aggregation through horizontal-then-vertical state-space propagation, allowing vertical updates to operate on horizontally contextualized features and thereby encouraging a structured two-dimensional receptive-field bias. AnchorCrossAttention performs inter-image aggregation by using cross-attention to gather context from plausible corresponding regions across the image pair. It performs this exchange over local representative anchors that aggregate feature evidence within each window. On MegaDepth, WAM achieves 66.1 pose AUC@5$^\circ$, improving on the JamMa baseline by 2.0 AUC points under the same evaluation setup. Ablations show that removing or replacing either specialized component reduces accuracy, providing evidence that intra-image propagation and inter-image retrieval benefit from role-specific aggregation designs. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/mmaiLab/WovenAnchorMatcher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WovenAnchor Matcher（WAM），一种面向半密集局部特征匹配的角色专化上下文聚合框架：通过WovenMamba进行图像内二维传播，通过AnchorCrossAttention进行图像间对应区域检索，并在MegaDepth上取得66.1 pose AUC@5°。
AI.motivation: 现有半密集匹配通常在粗到细对应估计前聚合上下文，但图像内聚合与图像间聚合具有不同功能：图像内需传播空间证据并保留二维结构依赖，图像间需从可能对应区域收集信息同时抑制无关位置噪声。若采用统一聚合机制，难以同时满足这两类目标。
AI.method: WAM提出两个互补算子：WovenMamba通过先水平后垂直的状态空间传播实现图像内聚合，使垂直更新基于已水平上下文化的特征，从而鼓励结构化二维感受野偏置；AnchorCrossAttention通过局部代表性锚点聚合窗口内特征证据，并利用跨图像交叉注意力从可能对应区域检索上下文，实现图像间聚合。
AI.result: 在MegaDepth基准上，WAM达到66.1的pose AUC@5°，相比JamMa基线在同一评测设置下提升2.0 AUC点。消融实验表明，移除或替换任一专化组件都会降低精度，支持图像内传播与图像间检索应采用角色特定聚合设计的观点。
AI.conclusion: 将半密集匹配中的上下文聚合按角色拆分为图像内空间传播和图像间对应检索，比统一聚合更有效。WovenMamba有助于保留二维结构信息，AnchorCrossAttention有助于聚焦可靠跨图对应，两者结合可提升局部特征匹配和位姿估计性能。

title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
summary: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DRILL框架，用于训练面向VLA强化学习的视频世界模型：不再仅以像素预测误差为目标，而是直接优化世界模型对策略学习信号与最终回报的贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在VLA策略后训练中通常通过下一步像素MSE进行训练，但其实际作用是为想象rollout提供可用于改进策略的学习信号。论文指出像素预测更准确并不必然带来更好的策略梯度，甚至可能更差，因此需要使世界模型训练目标与下游策略效用一致。
AI.method: 作者提出Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop（DRILL）这一双层框架，外层更新世界模型以最大化策略在内层GRPO更新后的想象rollout回报。该方法有两种实现：DRILL-VWI为无需额外模拟器rollouts的闭式代理目标，通过策略访问频率、组相对GRPO优势和模型置信度对预测误差重加权；DRILL-IMG为完整元梯度方法，通过截断Hessian向量积对内部GRPO更新进行反向传播。论文还证明在score-compatible和小残差假设下，DRILL-VWI可恢复DRILL-IMG元梯度的局部单步成分。
AI.result: 在五个操作仿真环境和两种VLA主干模型上，DRILL-IMG相比WMPO平均成功率提高13.1个百分点，相比RLVR-World提高7.9个百分点，并与RLVR预训练形成互补而非竞争关系。实验还显示，以策略效用训练的世界模型即使像素MSE高17%，也可能产生更好的下游策略。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，面向VLA强化学习的视频世界模型不应仅按像素预测保真度训练，而应由其产生的策略梯度和学习信号直接塑造。DRILL通过双层优化将世界模型训练与下游策略回报对齐，为更有效的环境交互减少型策略后训练提供了新范式。

title: Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual perception should be iterative and task-directed, with representations refined in response to the question and the need for further processing. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly support extended reasoning, their visual tokens are still typically acquired in a single, task-agnostic encoder pass. This creates an evidence-acquisition bottleneck: models may reason longer without refining the visual evidence needed to answer the question. We propose LoopLook, a lightweight encoder-side recurrent perception framework that equips pretrained VLMs with adaptive visual depth. LoopLook recurrently revisits a middle-to-late window of the vision encoder, injecting question representations at each loop to guide visual refinement. A learned stopping mechanism adaptively determines the recurrent depth, while a token-wise Mixture-of-Looks (MoL) combines representations from different loops, allowing each visual token to selectively integrate information acquired across recurrent steps. Across four backbones and eight benchmarks, LoopLook consistently improves performance over the baseline, yielding gains of up to 8.6% on MMStar and 8.1% on HallusionBench. Our analysis shows that LoopLook progressively refines visual attention and adaptively allocates depth according to task difficulty. It also better preserves task-relevant visual information under reduced input resolution, while increasing time to first token (TTFT) by only 5.1-6.5%. By bringing recurrence from reasoning back into perception, LoopLook transforms visual perception from a one-shot glimpse into an adaptive process of recurrent refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopLook，一种轻量级编码器侧循环感知框架，通过反复访问视觉编码器的中后层窗口、注入问题表示、学习停止机制和Token级Mixture-of-Looks，使视觉表示能随问题自适应迭代细化，从而缓解VLM中视觉证据单次获取的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型虽支持延长推理，但视觉token通常仍由单次、任务无关的编码器提取。这种“一次性视觉获取”造成证据采集瓶颈：模型可能更久推理，却未能根据问题进一步精炼所需的视觉证据。
AI.method: LoopLook在预训练VLM的视觉编码器中引入循环感知：反复访问编码器的中后层窗口，并在每轮循环中注入问题表示以引导视觉特征细化；同时设计可学习停止机制以自适应确定循环深度；再通过token级Mixture-of-Looks聚合不同循环中的表示，使每个视觉token选择性地整合跨循环信息。
AI.result: 在4个VLM主干和8个基准上，LoopLook均相对基线带来一致性能提升，在MMStar上最高提升8.6%，在HallusionBench上最高提升8.1%。分析显示，该方法能逐步细化视觉注意力、按任务难度自适应分配循环深度，并在降低输入分辨率时更好地保留任务相关视觉信息；时间到首token仅增加5.1%-6.5%。
AI.conclusion: LoopLook将循环机制从语言推理侧重新引入视觉感知侧，使视觉感知从一次性观察转变为面向问题、可自适应深度的迭代细化过程，为提升VLM视觉证据获取能力提供了轻量而有效的方案。

title: One Evaluation Is Enough: Inversion-Free Image Editing with Trajectory Correction
summary: Real-image editing commonly relies on inversion and iterative sampling, while efficient one-step editors often stabilize a large update by estimating and averaging editing fields at multiple noise levels. We ask a stricter question: is a single temporal field evaluation sufficient for reliable inversion-free editing? Our answer rests on a previously underused duality in a variance-preserving (VP) one-step model: one source-target query at a shared noisy state simultaneously determines a local angular semantic tangent and a clean endpoint displacement. We integrate the tangent over the analytically known remaining VP angle to obtain a nominal one-step transport, and use the endpoint displacement to correct its long-horizon extrapolation through a constrained projection. This transport-first, correction-second construction yields Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT), a closed-form, training-free editor requiring only one noise level, two text conditions packed into one denoiser batch, and one latent update.
