ECT requires no image inversion, trajectory integration, second temporal observation, or iterative optimization, and can be directly applied to pretrained epsilon-prediction VP one-step generators. Across the reported benchmark settings, ECT delivers stable gains in editing quality within an extremely short editing time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT)：一种面向真实图像编辑的闭式、免训练、一步反演自由编辑方法，仅在一次噪声状态评估中同时利用角语义切线和干净端点位移，实现稳定的高质量一步编辑。
AI.motivation: 真实图像编辑通常依赖反演和迭代采样，效率较低；现有高效一步编辑虽快，但往往需要在多个噪声级别估计并平均编辑场以稳定大幅更新。作者进一步追问：仅一次时间场评估是否足以实现可靠的反演自由编辑。
AI.method: 该方法利用方差保持型一步模型中一种此前较少使用的对偶性：在共享噪声状态下，一个源—目标查询同时确定局部角语义切线和干净端点位移。ECT 首先沿解析已知的剩余 VP 角度积分切线，得到名义一步传输；随后利用端点位移通过约束投影校正长程外推，从而构造先传输、后校正的编辑机制。整个过程只需要一个噪声级别、打包在一个去噪批中的两个文本条件以及一次潜变量更新，无需反演、轨迹积分、第二次时间观察或迭代优化。
AI.result: 在所报告的基准设置中，ECT 能够在极短编辑时间内稳定提升编辑质量，并可直接应用于预训练的 epsilon-prediction VP 一步生成器。
AI.conclusion: ECT 表明，单点时间场评估结合端点校正足以支撑可靠的反演自由一步图像编辑，为高效、免训练、闭式真实图像编辑提供了新范式。

title: RECAP: Looking Once Is Not Enough for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves vision-language models (VLMs), but it also exposes a temporal grounding failure: as generation unfolds, models may drift from image evidence while reinforcement learning still provides only a final-answer reward. We study this gap through visual revisit, a temporally localized reactivation of image evidence during reasoning. Across three VLM backbones, revisit peaks are predictive of correctness and causally linked to performance: masking them degrades accuracy more than masking non-peaks, while injecting revisit-like peaks into failed rollouts partially restores correct answers. Control analyses show that this signal is not explained by raw attention strength, uncertainty, logit margin, or hidden-state norm. We propose RECAP, a GRPO-compatible training method that turns detached revisit traces into a credit-assignment signal. RECAP uses revisit-conditioned advantage estimation, dynamic discounting, and gated value prediction to propagate final rewards through visually important reasoning steps, without extra rewards, additional rollouts, or inference-time changes. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B, and LLaVA-OV-7B, RECAP consistently improves over GRPO and VPPO, yielding $+6.1$--$+6.5$ HallusionBench gains over the SFT base while preserving reasoning and text-only performance. Results on larger LoRA-tuned models, Chinese zero-shot benchmarks, visual perturbations, and human evaluation further demonstrate robust improvements in image-grounded reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出长链式思维推理会使视觉语言模型在生成过程中逐渐偏离图像证据，并提出“视觉重访”这一时序定位证据再激活机制；基于该信号，作者设计RECAP强化学习方法，将最终奖励通过关键视觉推理步骤进行信用分配，从而提升图像接地推理能力。
AI.motivation: 长链式思维能够增强VLMs推理，但生成过程会造成时序上的视觉接地失败：模型可能逐步漂移并忽略图像证据，而现有强化学习通常只给出最终答案奖励，难以对中间视觉关键步骤进行有效归因和强化。
AI.method: 首先，作者将“视觉重访”定义为推理过程中对图像证据的局部再激活，并通过跨backbone分析、因果干预和控制实验验证其与推理正确性的关系。随后提出RECAP：一种兼容GRPO的训练方法，利用解耦的视觉重访轨迹作为信用分配信号，通过重访条件化优势估计、动态折扣和门控值预测，将最终奖励传播到视觉重要的中间推理步骤，不增加额外奖励、rollout或推理阶段改动。
AI.result: 视觉重访峰值能预测推理正确性，并具有因果性：遮蔽重访峰值比遮蔽非峰值更显著降低准确率，向失败轨迹注入重访式峰值可部分恢复正确答案。RECAP在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B和LLaVA-OV-7B上一致优于GRPO和VPPO，相较SFT基线在HallusionBench提升约+6.1至+6.5分，同时保持推理能力和纯文本性能；在更大LoRA模型、中文零样本基准、视觉扰动和人工评估中也有稳健收益。
AI.conclusion: 视觉重访为长链推理中的图像证据漂移提供了可检测、可干预的中间信号；RECAP通过将该信号用于RL信用分配，有效缓解最终答案奖励稀疏导致的视觉接地不足问题，为提升VLMs图像接地推理提供了无需额外监督的高效训练路径。

title: CAVC: Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache for Modality-Asymmetric Diffusion Generation
summary: Diffusion-based audio-visual generation methods typically perform joint denoising of audio and video latents throughout the entire sampling trajectory, repeatedly executing modality-specific denoising branches and cross-modal attention at every timestep. However, we observe that such uniform joint computation is not always necessary. The key is a modality-asymmetric recoverability: audio-side drift introduced by mid-stage caching can be substantially reduced by only a few terminal joint denoising steps, whereas video-side degradation caused by caching leads to persistent loss of motion and temporal details. This asymmetry suggests that inference acceleration should selectively cache recoverable audio-side computation while preserving full video refinement. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache (CAVC)}, a training-free modality-asymmetric caching framework. CAVC adopts a sandwich-structured computation allocation: after detecting that audio denoiser outputs enter a cache-tolerant regime, it caches and reuses the audio denoiser output to bypass audio denoising and cross-modal attention in the middle stage, while the video branch continues independent spatio-temporal refinement; a few joint steps are then restored at the end to reduce accumulated cross-modal drift and improve synchronization. Experiments across multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that CAVC achieves 1.10--1.35x wall-clock acceleration, improves several visual dynamics and temporal statistics, and maintains competitive audio fidelity and audio-visual alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出CAVC，一种训练无关的模态非对称缓存框架，通过选择性缓存可恢复的音频去噪分支并保留视频分支完整细化，实现音频视觉扩散生成推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式音频视觉生成方法在每个采样时间步都进行音视频联合去噪、模态特定去噪分支和跨模态注意力计算，但均匀联合计算并非必要。作者观察到音频侧由中期缓存引入的漂移可通过少量末尾联合去噪恢复，而视频侧缓存会导致运动和时序细节的持续损失，因此推理加速应利用这种模态非对称可恢复性。
AI.method: CAVC采用三明治式计算分配：检测音频去噪器输出进入可缓存范围后，缓存并复用音频去噪输出，在中间阶段绕过音频去噪和跨模态注意力；视频分支仍继续独立时空细化；最后恢复少量联合去噪步数，以减轻累积跨模态漂移并改善音画同步。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上，CAVC取得1.10至1.35倍墙钟加速，并改善多项视觉动态和时序统计指标，同时保持有竞争力的音频保真度与音画对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 音频与视频在扩散生成中表现出不同的缓存恢复能力，基于该模态非对称可恢复性设计选择性缓存策略，可在不重新训练模型的情况下有效加速音频视觉扩散生成并保持质量。

title: Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting from ODE-initialized checkpoints, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching uses maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. Together, these complementary signals allow a pretrained video model to learn causal continuation and the target video distribution in a single training stage. Dynamic Gradient Balancing adapts the relative gradient contributions of continuation alignment and distribution matching during training. Starting from bidirectional Wan2.1-1.3B, Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of dynamic gradient balancing and reveal distinct representation preferences: deeper features benefit continuation alignment, whereas intermediate features yield better performance for rollout distribution matching.

AI.tldr: Direct Forcing 是一个单阶段少步自回归视频生成训练框架，将因果续写学习与分布匹配合并，使预训练视频模型无需单独初始化或扩散分数监督即可快速得到低延迟生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成通常将因果适配与分布匹配分成不同训练阶段，导致流程复杂且依赖 ODE 初始化或在线监督；当目标分布由参考视频直接定义时，这种分离并不必要。
AI.method: 该方法以参考视频同时作为“历史如何续写”的成对示例和自生成 rollout 的目标分布来源：通过 Causal Continuation Alignment 学习在参考历史条件下的时空对应，通过 Rollout Distribution Matching 使用最大均值差异对齐自生成视频与参考视频的表示分布，并采用 Dynamic Gradient Balancing 动态调节两项损失的梯度贡献。
AI.result: 从双向 Wan2.1-1.3B 出发，Direct Forcing 仅需 250 次更新即可训练出四步自回归生成器，无需独立初始化阶段或在线 diffusion-score 监督，在 VBench 上达到 84.63 Total 和 86.01 Quality；消融还表明深度表示更适合续写对齐，而中间层表示更适合 rollout 分布匹配。
AI.conclusion: Direct Forcing 证明参考视频可同时支撑因果续写与分布匹配，使少步自回归视频生成能够在单一阶段高效训练，兼顾低延迟与视觉质量。

title: Cross-Spectral Feature Fusion for Multispectral Document Binarization
summary:
Historical document binarization remains challenging when faded ink, bleed-through, and background degradation exhibit wavelength-dependent behavior across visible and near-infrared observations. This study investigates whether adaptive cross-spectral feature fusion and targeted structural guidance can improve multispectral document binarization beyond fixed fusion and generic attention mechanisms.
  Four registered SMADI bands at 500, 600, 700, and 1000 nm are processed using a multi-branch conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN). Visible, NIR, and structural feature streams are fused at encoder depth L = 3 using spatial- and channel-wise softmax gating, while auxiliary edge maps derived from selected VIS-NIR band pairs provide targeted structural guidance. Nine controlled fusion and structural configurations are evaluated using five-fold document-level cross-validation, DIBCO-standard metrics, and Holm-corrected statistical testing.
  The F3 + NIR edge-guided configuration provides the strongest overall performance among the evaluated models, achieving mean F1 = 0.7916, p-FM = 0.8044, and IoU = 0.6654. Relative to the fixed Mid AVG baseline, it improves F1 by 0.0269, p-FM by 0.0360, and IoU by 0.0321, with all three gains remaining statistically significant after Holm correction. Mean NRM and DRD are also reduced, although these reductions are not statistically significant after correction.
  Targeted cross-spectral structural guidance provides an effective mechanism for regulating intermediate multispectral fusion, improving primary foreground-overlap performance while retaining the complete four-band observation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种多分支条件生成对抗网络，通过可见光/近红外自适应跨谱融合与基于VIS–NIR边缘图的定向结构引导，提升退化历史文档的多光谱二值化性能。
AI.motivation: 历史文档中褪色墨迹、背面渗透和背景退化在可见光与近红外波段的响应不同，固定融合或通用注意力难以充分利用多光谱信息，因此需要研究自适应跨谱特征融合与结构引导是否能改善多光谱文档二值化。
AI.method: 使用四个配准SMADI波段（500、600、700、1000 nm），设计多分支cGAN，将可见光、近红外和结构特征流在编码器深度L=3处通过空间与通道softmax门控融合，并以选定的VIS–NIR波段对生成辅助边缘图提供定向结构引导；通过九种融合与结构配置、五折文档级交叉验证、DIBCO指标和Holm校正统计检验评估。
AI.result: F3 + NIR边缘引导配置总体最优，平均F1为0.7916，p-FM为0.8044，IoU为0.6654；相比固定Mid AVG基线，F1、p-FM和IoU分别提升0.0269、0.0360和0.0321，且均通过Holm校正后保持显著；NRM和DRD也有下降，但校正后不显著。
AI.conclusion: 定向跨谱结构引导能够有效调控中间多光谱融合过程，在保留完整四波段观测的同时提升前景重叠类主指标；该方法对多光谱历史文档二值化具有实用价值，但对像素级误差指标如NRM和DRD的显著改善仍需进一步验证。

title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
summary: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection. Existing artifact-based detectors typically identify generation artifacts as evidence for source prediction, yet they may either fail to recognize subtle artifacts or reach the correct source decision without faithfully identifying the evidence underlying it. In this work, we systematically investigate how to design and train effective artifact detectors and formulate artifact detection as a structured process comprising three complementary capabilities: Inspection Planning, which determines what should be examined; Evidence Verification, which verifies whether the inspected content exhibits genuine generation artifacts; and Evidence Aggregation, which integrates the verified evidence into the final source decision. Building on this formulation, we introduce Verus-Insight, trained with human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training to strengthen both fine-grained artifact detection and video-level detection. We further introduce Verus-Bench, a benchmark with fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts for evaluating artifact detection. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Verus-Insight achieves strong performance in both fine-grained artifact analysis and AI-generated video detection, with substantial gains in recovering human-perceived artifacts. Further analyses reveal that the three capabilities are complementary yet distinct, and that Verus-Insight more reliably converts relevant inspection targets into supported artifact evidence without increasing spurious artifact claims.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将AI生成视频中的“生成伪影检测”拆解为“检查规划—证据验证—证据聚合”的结构化流程，并基于此构建Verus-Insight模型与Verus-Bench基准，以提升细粒度伪影识别和视频来源判断的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成技术快速发展，合成视频越来越逼真，现有基于伪影的检测器常面临两类问题：一是难以捕捉细微生成伪影；二是虽然能给出正确的来源判断，但并未真实识别出支持该判断的伪影证据，导致检测过程缺乏可解释性和可靠性。
AI.method: 作者将伪影检测定义为包含三个互补能力的结构化过程：Inspection Planning用于确定应检查的内容区域或对象；Evidence Verification用于判断被检查内容是否真实包含生成伪影；Evidence Aggregation用于将已验证的伪影证据整合为最终的视频来源决策。随后提出Verus-Insight模型，采用人类标注的全流程监督信号和渐进式能力训练，以同时增强细粒度伪影检测能力和视频级检测能力。另构建Verus-Bench，提供关于可感知伪影的细粒度人工标注，用于评估模型对人工感知伪影的恢复能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验显示，Verus-Insight在细粒度伪影分析和AI生成视频检测任务中均表现较强，尤其在恢复人类感知伪影方面取得显著提升。进一步分析表明，三种检测能力互补但各具作用；Verus-Insight能够更可靠地将相关检查目标转化为有支撑的伪影证据，同时没有增加虚假伪影声称。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过显式建模伪影证据的发现、验证与聚合过程，提升了AI生成视频检测的细粒度感知能力和决策可靠性。Verus-Insight和Verus-Bench为可解释、证据驱动的生成视频检测提供了新的方法与评测基础。

title: HimmBO: High-Dimensional Interactive Model-Merging Bayesian Optimization for Image Generation
summary: Fine-tuning has become a common way to customize text-to-image models, leading to community collections of over 100K lightweight adapters. Adapters sharing a base model can be merged with continuous coefficients. This turns a large collection into a high-dimensional continuous design space, which recent work explores interactively using preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO). However, existing approaches are limited to a few dozen preselected adapters and require expensive image generation in every interaction round. We introduce HimmBO, a two-stage method that scales preference-driven adapter merging to much larger collections while reducing image-generation cost. Its screening stage recovers the active adapter set through level-set estimation over pre-generated images, requiring no image generation. The refinement stage then optimizes merge coefficients in the recovered low-dimensional subspace. Both stages use a style-aware kernel, allowing preference information to transfer between visually similar adapters. In simulated-user image-matching experiments, HimmBO achieves higher final similarity than all comparisons while reaching a given similarity with under one tenth of the image generations required by prior work. Its performance remains stable as the collection grows to 1080 adapters, while competing methods degrade substantially.

AI.tldr: HimmBO是一种面向文本生成图像模型LoRA/轻量适配器合并的偏好驱动优化方法，通过“先筛查、后精调”的两阶段框架，将大规模适配器集合上的连续合并系数优化从昂贵图像生成交互中解放出来。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只能处理少量预选适配器，并且每轮偏好交互都需要实际生成图像，导致大规模适配器集合（如社区中超过10万个适配器）上的偏好式合并搜索成本高、扩展性差。
AI.method: 方法包含两阶段：第一阶段为筛查阶段，利用预先生成的图像和level-set估计恢复出“活跃适配器集合”，无需在线生成图像；第二阶段为精调阶段，在恢复得到的低维子空间上优化合并系数。两阶段均采用风格感知核函数，使偏好信息能够在视觉风格相似的适配器之间迁移，从而提升学习效率。
AI.result: 在模拟用户的图像匹配实验中，HimmBO最终相似度高于所有对比方法，同时达到给定相似度所需的图像生成次数不到先前方法的十分之一。当适配器集合扩展到1080个时，HimmBO性能保持稳定，而对比方法显著下降。
AI.conclusion: HimmBO证明了大规模适配器集合上进行偏好驱动合并的可行性，其通过预生成图像筛查、低维子空间精调和风格感知核函数有效降低了图像生成交互成本，并显著增强了对大规模适配器库的扩展能力。

title: When Annotation Patterns Are Learned: Skin-Tone Dependence in Dermatology Concepts
summary: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) let clinicians inspect and correct skin disease diagnoses through clinical concepts, but only if the concept annotations are reliable. We therefore audit the reliability of SkinCon, a widely used dermatology concept dataset, across skin tones. Within the same disease and with near duplicates removed, erythema is annotated far less often on dark than on light skin, with an odds ratio of 0.17. In contrast, hyperpigmentation and hypopigmentation are annotated more often, with odds ratios of 6.2 and 4.5, respectively. We refer to this pattern as tone-dependent concept annotation. An evidential concept model trained on these annotations learns the same pattern and reproduces it on unseen images. Such a model may agree with potential erythema omissions rather than contradict them. Consistent with this, three label error detectors underperform a disease-only baseline at finding erythema that dermatologist captions mention but SkinCon labels as absent. The three detectors are based on confident learning, training dynamics, and the model's own evidential uncertainty. Concept annotations should thus be audited within each subgroup before explanations built on them can be trusted.

AI.tldr: 论文发现 SkinCon 皮肤病概念标注存在“肤色依赖的标注偏差”，尤其是红斑在深肤色中显著漏标，导致基于这些标注训练的概念模型继承并复现该偏差，因此用于解释和纠错的概念标注必须先做子群体审计。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型依赖可靠的概念标注来支持医生检查和纠正皮肤疾病诊断；但不同肤色之间概念标注是否一致、是否有系统性偏差尚未充分验证。
AI.method: 作者审计 SkinCon 数据集，在控制疾病类别并移除近似重复样本后，比较不同肤色下红斑、色素沉着过多和色素沉着过少的标注频率；随后训练 evidential concept model 检验其是否学习并复现这种“tone-dependent concept annotation”；再用三种标签错误检测方法（confident learning、training dynamics、模型自身 evidential uncertainty）识别皮肤科医生描述中提到但 SkinCon 标注为不存在的红斑，并与疾病单一基线比较。
AI.result: 深肤色样本中红斑被标注的概率显著低于浅肤色样本，比值比为 0.17；而色素沉着过多和过少的标注比值比分别为 6.2 和 4.5。基于这些标注训练的概念模型学到并复现了相同模式。三种标签错误检测器在发现被遗漏的红斑方面均不如疾病基线，说明模型可能默认接受这些漏标。
AI.conclusion: 概念标注本身可能包含肤色相关系统性错误，直接基于其构建的解释和纠错不可完全可靠；在信任概念解释前，必须按各子群体对概念标注进行审计。

title: Query-Time Calibration of CLIP Features for Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
summary: Lifting vision-language features such as CLIP into 3D Gaussian reconstructions enables open-vocabulary segmentation through natural-language queries. Although CLIP represents a broad range of semantic concepts, the lifted features of individual scenes can exhibit strong directional concentration, while raw cosine similarity does not account for the scene-specific feature distribution. We show that substantial segmentation gains can be obtained by changing how a fixed lifted feature field is compared with text. Our method partially subtracts a shared scene direction from visual features and text prototypes and whitens text prototypes using a fixed reference vocabulary of generic terms. It then uses soft clustering for multiclass prediction and CSLS with a relevance margin against the reference vocabulary for single-query prediction. Beyond reducing directional concentration, scene centering improves class-relative feature separation in every evaluated scene. Across seven lifting methods and four datasets, the resulting query-time calibration consistently improves mean intersection over union in both multiclass and single-query segmentation. These gains require no retraining, source-image re-encoding, or feature re-lifting, demonstrating the value of scene-conditioned comparison for making better use of existing lifted representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需重新训练的查询时校准方法，通过去除场景共享方向、文本原型白化、软聚类和带参考词表的相关性间隔，显著提升开放词汇 3D Gaussian 场景分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有将 CLIP 等视觉-语言特征提升到 3D Gaussian 表征中可支持开放词汇分割，但单个场景中提升后的视觉特征存在强烈方向集中性；原始余弦相似度没有考虑场景特定的特征分布，导致文本查询与视觉特征之间的比较不够鲁棒，限制分割质量。
AI.method: 方法不改变已有提升特征场，而是在查询比较阶段进行场景条件化校准：1）从视觉特征和文本原型中部分减去共享场景方向，以降低场景特征的方向集中性；2）使用固定通用参考词表对文本原型进行白化，缓解文本嵌入分布偏置；3）多类预测采用软聚类；4）单查询预测采用 CSLS 度量，并引入相对于参考词表的相关性间隔，以增强查询相关类别与无关类别的可区分性。整个过程无需重新训练、无需重新编码源图像、也无需重新提升特征。
AI.result: 在七种特征提升方法和四个数据集上，该方法在平均 IoU 上均取得稳定提升，适用于多类分割和单查询分割。实验表明，场景中心化不仅降低方向集中性，还在所有评估场景中改善了类间相对特征分离，证明改进固定提升特征与文本之间的比较方式即可带来明显增益。
AI.conclusion: 提升后的视觉-语言 3D Gaussian 表征本身已具有一定能力，但原始文本-视觉相似度比较没有充分利用场景特定分布信息。通过查询时的场景条件化校准，可以在零重训、零重提升的条件下显著增强开放词汇分割性能，说明“如何比较”与“如何提升特征”同样关键。

title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
comment: 8 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/sungkites/HFCMA
summary: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HFCMA：一种面向细粒度图文检索的层次化跨模态对齐框架，先将图像块和文本词元自适应聚合为视觉区域与文本短语，再通过熵正则最优传输实现区域-短语的结构化匹配，以提升对物体、属性、数量、动作和关系等局部语义差异的区分能力。
AI.motivation: 细粒度图文检索不仅要求判断图像与文本的全局语义一致性，还需要建模文本局部语义对应的视觉证据，如对象、属性、数量、动作和关系。现有方法通常依赖固定图像块、检测区域或文本词元作为匹配单元，并通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似度累加等方式聚合局部交互，在语义单元构建和全局匹配一致性方面存在局限。
AI.method: HFCMA 包含三个核心机制：1）动态粒度发现，将底层图像 patch 和文本 token 聚合为语义更紧凑的视觉区域和文本短语；2）将区域-短语匹配建模为熵正则化最优传输问题，在全局边缘约束下估计结构化对齐矩阵；3）引入背景去偏、文本重要性加权以及原型一致性正则，以降低背景噪声和局部语义漂移，并在双编码器检索框架内将细粒度局部对齐分数融入全局检索评分。
AI.result: 在 Flickr30K 和 MS-COCO 上的实验表明，HFCMA 能够有效结合动态语义单元构建与基于最优传输的结构化匹配，使细粒度评分为候选排序提供更明确的局部对齐信息，并提升模型对细微语义差异的判别能力。
AI.conclusion: HFCMA 表明，细粒度图文检索的关键不在于简单扩大局部匹配单元或聚合相似度，而在于自适应构建语义匹配单元，并通过结构化约束建立全局一致的跨模态对齐。动态区域/短语生成与最优传输匹配能够增强局部证据利用，从而改善检索性能和语义区分度。

title: Watch and Learn: Teaching Visual In-Context Learning by Removing Textual Shortcuts
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with in context learning compared to their textual counterparts. Our preliminary study shows that VLMs rely on textual shortcuts and underutilize the visual demonstrations. We therefore hypothesize that VLMs are insufficiently trained to perform visual in-context learning (vICL). To this end, we construct MIME, a task-agnostic vICL training set without textual shortcuts. We ensure the instruction does not state the rule linking the demonstration images to their answers, so the model must infer it from the visual demonstrations. Fine-tuning on MIME improves vICL accuracy by 8.1 to 18.0 points across three VLMs, preserves single-image performance, and improves multi-image and text only in-context learning. In contrast, stating the rule in the training data sharply reduces this gain. We further propose DTAD (Demonstration Text Attention Dropout), which randomly withholds demonstration labels during training so that the VLM must infer the rule from the demonstration images. While achieving comparable vICL accuracy to fine-tuning on MIME, DTAD yields more consistent attention to the demonstration images. On TrueMICL, Qwen3-VL-8B trained on MIME matches frontier models such as Claude Opus 5, and surpasses them with DTAD. Finally, adding MIME to the instruction-tuning mix of LLaVA 1.5 13B more than doubles its vICL accuracy without hurting single-image abilities, whereas a same-size multi-image set improves it only slightly. These results suggest that vICL data should be a standard component of VLM training.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出视觉语言模型在视觉上下文学习中依赖文本捷径、未能充分利用图像示例，并提出通过构建无文本捷径的视觉上下文学习训练集 MIME，以及采用 DTAD 注意力/标签扰动训练方法，显著提升模型从图像中推断任务规则的能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型相比纯文本模型在上下文学习中表现较弱，初步分析认为其原因是模型容易借助文本说明或示例标签形成捷径，而不是真正利用视觉示例中的信息。因此需要验证模型是否缺乏足够的视觉上下文学习训练，并探索如何增强其从图像中归纳任务规则的能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个任务无关、避免文本捷径的视觉上下文学习训练集 MIME，其指令不直接说明示例图像与答案之间的规则，迫使模型从视觉示例中推断。进一步提出 DTAD，即在训练过程中随机隐藏或扰动示例标签，使模型更依赖图像而非文本标注完成推理，并观察其注意力模式与上下文学习性能变化。
AI.result: 在三个视觉语言模型上，使用 MIME 微调可带来 8.1 到 18.0 点的视觉上下文学习准确率提升，同时保持单图像性能，并提升多图和纯文本上下文学习能力。若训练指令直接说明规则，性能增益明显下降。DTAD 能取得与 MIME 微调相当的视觉上下文学习效果，但使模型对示例图像的注意力更一致。在 TrueMICL 上，经过 MIME 训练的 Qwen3-VL-8B 可达到前沿模型水平，加入 DTAD 后甚至超越相关对比模型。对 LLaVA 1.5 13B 的指令微调混合数据中加入 MIME 后，视觉上下文学习准确率提升超过一倍，而加入同规模的普通多图数据提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 视觉上下文学习需要专门的、避免文本捷径的训练数据。将 MIME 等视觉上下文学习数据纳入视觉语言模型的指令微调流程，是提升其真正利用图像示例进行推理能力的重要方向。

title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
summary: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

AI.tldr: 论文提出因子感知预测学习（FAPL），面向电影级视频生成，强化多模态大模型（MLLM）潜特征对视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的有效使用，并联合提升稀疏输入下的时序推断能力以及角色、场景、动作、相机等因子的可控编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 电影级视频生成不仅需要基于稀疏条件而非逐帧引导进行时序预测，还需要对角色、场景、动作和相机等多种生成因子进行解耦控制。MLLM能够提供有用的多模态先验，但其表示并不天然适合视频生成：一方面，DiT可能绕过MLLM原生条件路径而不充分利用这些潜特征；另一方面，直接使用MLLM特征并不保证因子感知控制，也不保证生成兼容的时序预测。因此，需要一种机制使MLLM的语义先验能够被视频生成器有效利用，并分别针对控制与预测能力给出明确训练信号。
AI.method: 作者提出Factor-Aware Predictive Learning（FAPL），以“有效利用MLLM潜表示”作为共同前提，并用互补学习信号分别增强两类能力。方法包括三部分：1）潜特征引导的生成器接地：在冻结MLLM和连接器的情况下训练DiT，迫使生成器从纯潜特征中学到可用于视频生成的表示；2）因子感知控制：构造配对视频，明确指定目标因子的变化与非目标因子的保持，并通过factor-span replacement让DiT在输出中实现该因子替换关系；3）时序推断：设计仅文本观察与文本加完整视频观察共享同一视频目标的训练方式，先训练DiT后冻结DiT，再通过DiT反向优化MLLM和连接器，使有限输入下的表征具备生成兼容性，同时保留完整观测重建作为互补训练模式。
AI.result: 在稀疏到视频生成、因子感知视频编辑和多镜头视频生成三类电影级视频生成任务上，FAPL相比基线取得一致更优表现。实验验证了该方法对MLLM特征使用、时序控制能力以及多因子协调生成能力的提升作用。
AI.conclusion: FAPL的核心思想是将“让视频生成器真正可用、可控地利用MLLM潜特征”作为统一前提，再通过分别针对因子替换和稀疏时序预测的训练信号提升电影级视频生成能力。该工作表明，单纯接入MLLM并不足以实现可控视频生成，需要通过面向生成的接地训练和因子感知/时序预测学习，才能使多模态先验真正转化为高质量视频生成与控制能力。

title: ICGF-CXRMate: Image-Conditioned Clinical Context Compression and Gated Fusion for Chest X-ray Report Generation
summary: Auxiliary patient data can improve chest X-ray report generation, but directly concatenating heterogeneous clinical information with visual tokens produces long, variable-length decoder prompts and may expose the model to redundant or image-irrelevant context. We propose ICGF-CXRMate, an image-conditioned clinical context compression and gated fusion framework. Learnable queries are first conditioned on the current chest X-ray representations and then attend to the patient-data sequence, compressing it into a fixed number of clinical context tokens. Gated cross-attention selectively integrates these tokens into the visual stream, while the compressed tokens are retained in the decoder prompt as a direct clinical pathway. Experiments on linked MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV-ED examinations show that ICGF-CXRMate improves report quality while reducing the average prompt length. In Stage~2, it improves RadGraph-F1 from 24.00 to 28.86, CXR-BERT similarity from 56.86 to 62.80, and BLEU-4 from 5.14 to 7.96 compared with CXRMate-ED, while reducing the average prompt length from 373.89 to 288.37 tokens, corresponding to a 22.9\% reduction. After self-critical sequence training, ICGF-CXRMate outperforms CXRMate-ED on six of eight report-quality metrics in Stage~3. Ablation studies confirm the complementary contributions of image-conditioned compression, gated fusion, and direct retention of the compressed clinical tokens.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ICGF-CXRMate，通过图像条件化的临床上下文压缩与门控融合，将辅助患者数据更有效地融入胸片报告生成，在提升报告质量的同时缩短提示长度。
AI.motivation: 胸片报告生成中，辅助患者数据可提供有用临床信息，但直接将其与视觉token拼接会导致解码器提示过长、长度不稳定，并可能引入冗余或与图像无关的上下文。因此需要一种既能利用临床信息、又能压缩噪声并抑制无关上下文的融合机制。
AI.method: 方法核心是ICGF-CXRMate。首先使用可学习查询，并以当前胸片视觉表示作为条件，对辅助患者数据序列进行注意力压缩，生成固定数量的临床上下文token。随后通过门控交叉注意力将这些压缩后的临床token选择性整合到视觉流中。同时，这些压缩token也被直接保留在解码器提示中，形成一条额外的临床信息通路。实验基于MIMIC-CXR与MIMIC-IV-ED关联检查进行评测。
AI.result: 在Stage 2中，ICGF-CXRMate相较CXRMate-ED显著提升报告质量：RadGraph-F1从24.00提高到28.86，CXR-BERT相似度从56.86提高到62.80，BLEU-4从5.14提高到7.96；同时平均提示长度从373.89降到288.37个token，减少22.9%。经自临界序列训练后，在Stage 3的八项报告质量指标中，有六项优于CXRMate-ED。消融实验进一步验证了图像条件压缩、门控融合和压缩临床token直接保留机制的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: ICGF-CXRMate能够在不直接拼接长临床上下文的情况下，更有效地利用辅助患者数据，实现胸片报告生成质量提升与解码提示压缩，是一种适用于多模态医学报告生成的图像条件化上下文压缩与融合方案。

title: Attention-guided classification and tumor localization of combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma
summary: Combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinomas (cHCC-CCA) are a type of cancer that share components of two other primary liver cancers: hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and cholangiocarcinoma (CCA). Accurate diagnosis of cHCC-CCA, of which the behavior may resemble that of either HCC or CCA, remains a challenge due to strong intratumoral heterogeneity. Since the prognoses differ between liver cancer types, it is necessary to improve their morphological characterization and recognition in order to accurately identify cHCC-CCA. In this work, we use whole slide images (WSIs) of the two main types of liver cancer (HCC and CCA) and cHCC-CCA, stained with Hematoxylin-Eosin-Safran (HES), to train a classification model that can distinguish between these subtypes and provides a potential solution for localizing different types of tumors in the combined liver cancer images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用全切片图像训练分类模型，以区分 HCC、CCA 和 cHCC-CCA，并有望定位混合性肝癌中的不同肿瘤成分。
AI.motivation: cHCC-CCA 兼具肝细胞癌和胆管癌成分，且肿瘤内部异质性强，准确诊断困难；不同肝癌亚型预后不同，需要改进形态学表征与识别。
AI.method: 使用 HCC、CCA 和 cHCC-CCA 的 HES 染色全切片图像训练分类模型，以区分肝癌亚型，并探索对 cHCC-CCA 中不同类型肿瘤区域进行定位。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集规模、评价指标或定量结果，仅表明该分类模型能够区分三种肝癌亚型，并为混合性肝癌中的肿瘤类型定位提供潜在方案。
AI.conclusion: 基于全切片图像的分类模型有助于提高 cHCC-CCA 的识别与形态学分析，但文中摘要缺少实验结果和验证细节，临床可应用性仍需进一步证据支持。

title: GraphCAD: Geometry-Aware Diffusion on Edge-Adjacency Graphs for CAD Generation
summary: Generative modeling for Computer-Aided Design (CAD) remains fundamentally challenged by the need to capture the intricate interplay between discrete topological connectivity and precise spatial geometry inherent in Boundary Representations (B-reps). Existing generative approaches largely formulate CAD construction as a sequence modeling problem, but consequently lack an explicit topological inductive bias. In this work, we present GraphCAD, a geometry-aware generative framework that centers modeling on the Edge-Adjacency Graph (EAG), a novel graph-based CAD representation tailored for generative tasks. GraphCAD adopts a hybrid graph diffusion formulation to jointly model the discrete and continuous components of EAG and introduces a geometry-aware denoising mechanism that renders node attributes into spatial point sets. These point sets are encoded by an SE(3)-equivariant backbone and fused into the node representations, thereby grounding the generative process in physical geometry. To support this study, we construct EAGBench, a large-scale dataset of engineering CAD models. Extensive experiments show that GraphCAD can generate complex CAD models with more than 50 faces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in geometric fidelity and distributional alignment compared with sequence-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraphCAD，一种以边邻接图为几何感知生成核心的CAD生成框架，通过混合图扩散和SE(3)等变编码联合建模拓扑与几何，并构建EAGBench数据集，在复杂CAD生成上取得更优的几何保真与分布对齐。
AI.motivation: CAD边界表示同时包含离散拓扑连接关系和连续精确几何结构，二者高度耦合。现有序列生成方法虽能将CAD建模为序列预测问题，但缺乏对拓扑结构的显式归纳偏置，难以同时保证合理拓扑和高质量几何。
AI.method: GraphCAD以面向生成任务的图表示Edge-Adjacency Graph为核心，采用混合图扩散联合建模EAG中的离散拓扑和连续几何成分。其几何感知去噪机制将节点属性解码为空间点集，再通过SE(3)等变主干编码这些点集并融合到节点表示中，使生成过程受到真实三维几何约束。同时，作者构建大规模工程CAD数据集EAGBench以支持训练与评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，GraphCAD能够生成包含50个以上面片的复杂CAD模型，并在几何保真度和生成分布与真实数据对齐程度方面优于基于序列的基线方法，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明以显式拓扑图为核心的生成框架能够更有效地融合CAD中的拓扑与几何信息，相比序列建模方法，GraphCAD为复杂、几何精确的工程CAD生成提供了更具物理一致性和拓扑合理性的建模路径。

title: Diagnostic Loss: Asymmetric Supervision for Radiology Report Generation
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/gmum/DLoss
summary: Automated radiology report generation requires models to do more than produce fluent clinical narratives: they must explicitly state supported diagnoses while avoiding unsupported ones. However, existing medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) are typically trained with token-level maximum likelihood objectives, which prioritize text agreement over diagnostically critical terms. As a result, models can miss key diagnoses and introduce wrong ones. We identify this as an objective misalignment between conventional language modeling and the asymmetric diagnostic requirements of radiology reporting. To encode these requirements, we introduce Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities. DLoss separately aggregates probability mass over vocabularies associated with diagnoses supported by the reference report and with unsupported alternatives. Using asymmetric pooling across token positions in the report, it encourages supported diagnoses to receive sufficient probability in at least one position while suppressing spurious probability spikes for unsupported diagnoses across all positions during training. The loss can be applied to existing 3D MedVLMs without modifying their vision backbones, language decoders, or inference procedures, and introduces no additional inference-time computation. We train and evaluate DLoss on 50,000 abdominal CT scans across several 3D MedVLM architectures on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution report-generation benchmarks. Across these settings, DLoss improves diagnostic faithfulness while maintaining competitive performance on conventional language-generation metrics, showing the value of asymmetric sequence-level supervision for radiology report generation. The code for DLoss is available at https://github.com/gmum/DLoss.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DLoss：一种面向医学视觉语言模型报告生成的可微分、架构无关的损失，通过非对称聚合诊断相关概率，提高诊断忠实度且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有MedVLM多用token级最大似然训练，偏向文本流畅性而忽视诊断正确性，导致漏报应有诊断或生成错误诊断。 radiology报告生成需要满足“支持诊断必须被表达、不支持诊断应避免”的非对称要求，但常规语言建模目标与此目标不匹配。
AI.method: 引入Diagnostic Loss（DLoss），直接作用于解码器token概率。分别对参考报告中支持的诊断词表和不支持的替代诊断词表进行概率质量聚合；通过跨报告token位置的非对称池化，训练时鼓励支持诊断在至少一个位置获得足够概率，同时抑制不支持诊断在所有位置出现异常概率峰值。该方法无需改动视觉主干、语言解码器或推理流程，也不增加推理计算。作者在5万个腹部CT扫描、多种3D MedVLM架构上训练和评估，并使用分布内与分布外报告生成基准测试。
AI.result: 在多个架构和设置下，DLoss提升了诊断忠实度，同时在传统语言生成指标上保持有竞争力的表现，说明非对称序列级监督对放射学报告生成有效。
AI.conclusion: 放射学报告生成不应只优化表面文本匹配，而应显式建模诊断正确性的非对称约束。DLoss提供了简单、可插拔、推理零开销的目标函数改进方案，可用于现有3D MedVLM以提高临床可靠性。

title: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
summary: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResGVC，一种面向生成式视频压缩的残差编码框架，通过传输残差信号并直接对像素域去噪来约束生成过程，显著提升重建质量与压缩效率。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频压缩通常依赖解码端扩散模型基于生成先验对潜空间中的重建信号去噪，但仅靠解码端生成缺乏对原始画面的显式约束，且潜表示瓶颈可能造成不可逆信息损失。
AI.method: ResGVC先用学习型视频编解码器编码原始视频，再将编解码重建结果与原始画面之间的失真分解为一系列随去噪步骤获得的残差段；随后提出一种以扩散Transformer为熵模型的新型残差编解码器对这些残差段进行压缩，并在整个去噪过程中注入显式源约束，同时直接在像素域进行去噪。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较于先前最先进方法，ResGVC在LPIPS和PSNR指标上分别实现63.7%和83.8%的BD-rate降低，且具有更优的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过传输压缩后的残差信号、扩散式熵建模以及像素域去噪，ResGVC有效缓解了生成式视频压缩中纯解码端生成和潜空间瓶颈带来的失真与保真度问题，显著提升了率失真性能。

title: A General-Purpose Dual-Path Interaction Framework for Multi-View Medical Image Segmentation: Alleviating Data Volume Dependency in Small-Sample Regimes
summary: The performance of medical image segmentation depends on a large amount of annotated data, and most segmentation models experience a significant drop in performance in low-sample-size scenarios. Existing semi-supervised and weakly supervised methods rely on specific network architectures, while traditional multi-view-assisted segmentation methods require strictly paired samples, which limits their clinical applications. To address these issues, we propose DPIF, a general-purpose plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework compatible with arbitrary encoder-decoder segmentation networks, which leverages cross-view anatomical complementarity to reduce annotation reliance. DPIF first performs Sinkhorn optimal transport-based cross-view distribution alignment to establish global semantic correspondence without sample-level pairing. It then adopts conditional mutual information-guided feature decoupling to enable bidirectional knowledge transfer only within the shared semantic space, suppressing view-specific noise. Finally, persistent homology-based topological regularization encodes anatomical invariants as unsupervised priors to mitigate overfitting. Experiments were conducted using 24 baseline models on a private multicenter echocardiography dataset and two public datasets. The results show that DPIF-enhanced models outperform single-view baseline models when trained on comparable amounts of data. Notably, most dual-path variants trained on 40\% - 60\% of the data achieve performance comparable to that of single-view models trained on the full dataset. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a general-purpose and scalable solution for data-scarce multi-view medical image segmentation problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPIF，一种即插即用的双路径交互框架，通过跨视角解剖互补、无配对语义对齐、共享语义知识迁移和拓扑先验正则化，缓解医学图像分割在小样本场景下的标注依赖与性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割通常依赖大量像素级标注，小样本训练会导致模型性能显著下降；现有半监督/弱监督方法往往绑定特定网络架构，传统多视角方法又需要严格配对的样本，限制了其在真实临床多视角影像场景中的适用性。
AI.method: 作者提出通用、可即插即用的双路径交互框架DPIF，可适配任意编码器-解码器分割网络。其核心包括三点：首先，基于Sinkhorn最优传输进行跨视角分布对齐，在不需要样本级配对的情况下建立全局语义对应；其次，采用条件互信息引导的特征解耦，使双向知识迁移仅发生在共享语义空间内，从而抑制视角特异性噪声；最后，引入基于持续同调的拓扑正则化，将解剖结构不变量编码为无监督先验，以减轻小样本条件下的过拟合。实验在私有多中心超声心动图数据集和两个公开数据集上进行，共测试24个基线模型。
AI.result: 在训练数据量相当的情况下，经DPIF增强的模型整体优于单视角基线模型；尤其是多数双路径变体仅使用40%–60%的训练数据，即可达到与使用全量数据的单视角模型相当的性能，说明该方法能显著降低标注需求并提升小样本分割鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DPIF为数据稀缺条件下的多视角医学图像分割提供了一种通用、可扩展且架构无关的解决方案，能够利用跨视角解剖互补信息提升低标注场景下的分割性能。摘要未充分说明其在跨中心部署、极端小样本或复杂病变更细粒度拓扑结构下的适用边界，这些可能需要进一步验证。

title: I$^2$-KAN: Interpretable Intra- and Inter-Modal Multi-Pathway Representation Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to infer sentiment by integrating linguistic, acoustic, and visual information. However, many fusion methods integrate modality-specific representations and cross-modal interactions into joint representations, making it difficult to determine whether predictive utility arises from a modality itself or from its interactions with others. More fundamentally, a modality's standalone predictive utility may not faithfully reflect its interaction-conditioned predictive utility. To address this issue, we propose I$^2$-KAN, an interpretable multi-pathway framework that explicitly maintains intra-modal and pairwise inter-modal information in separate structural pathways. Each pathway is refined by a Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck (TDL-GDB) to learn compact and task-relevant representations, followed by structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion that retains explicit pathway associations and supports multi-level interpretation. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS v2 demonstrate strong overall performance. Ablation and interpretability analyses consistently show across the three benchmarks that low standalone predictive utility does not necessarily imply low interaction-conditioned predictive utility: a modality that appears weak in isolation can remain informative through pairwise interactions. These findings highlight the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility and suggest that modality utility should be characterized from both standalone and interaction-conditioned perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释多路径框架 I²-KAN，将模态内部与跨模态交互信息分离建模，并用结构化 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network 融合与任务解耦线性门控去噪瓶颈提炼表示，在多个多模态情感分析基准上表现良好；实验表明模态的独立预测价值不一定代表其交互条件下的预测价值。
AI.motivation: 现有 MSA 融合方法常把模态特定表示与跨模态交互混合成联合表示，难以区分性能来自模态本身还是来自交互。同时，一个模态单独表现弱，不代表它在与其他模态交互时无用，因此需要显式保留内部路径与成对交互路径，并从独立预测效用和交互条件预测效用两个视角分析多模态贡献。
AI.method: 作者提出 I²-KAN，即显式维护模态内信息和成对模态间信息的可解释多路径框架。每个结构路径通过 Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck 学习紧凑且任务相关的表示，随后使用结构化 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network 进行融合，在保留路径关联的同时支持多层次解释。
AI.result: 在 CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI 和 CH-SIMS v2 上实验显示整体性能较强；消融和可解释性分析一致表明，独立预测效用低的模态可能在成对交互中仍具有信息性，即弱模态可能通过跨模态交互继续贡献预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 多模态预测价值具有交互依赖性，模态效用不能只按单独预测能力评估，而应同时考察其独立效用与交互条件下效用。分离建模模态内部与跨模态交互路径有助于性能提升和可解释分析。

title: DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories
summary: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout r of 0.480, outperforming the camera path alone (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (at most 0.429). DRAFT also works as a plug-in that improves all seven decoders without retraining, raising their layout r from 0.171-0.429 to 0.487-0.493. Brain activity and camera motion can thus recover the metric layout of unseen rooms, a first step toward reconstructing the 3D spaces people see.

AI.tldr: 提出DRAFT方法，仅利用被试观看室内行走视频时的fMRI信号和已知相机轨迹，重建未见房间的3D度量布局。
AI.motivation: 现有fMRI解码器可重建图像或3D物体，但从运动视角恢复房间的度量几何仍是开放难题，主要困难在于快速变化的视觉输入与时间上模糊的fMRI信号之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: DRAFT从早期视觉皮层提取紧凑的布局表征，并将其与由相机运动推导出的几何自由空间相融合；同时提出layout r指标，即预测布局与射线投射得到的对数深度之间的Pearson相关系数。
AI.result: 在10个未见场景和20名被试上，DRAFT达到0.480的layout r，优于仅使用相机路径的0.446和7种fMRI解码器的最高0.429；作为插件使用时，可将这7种解码器的layout r从0.171–0.429提升至0.487–0.493。
AI.conclusion: 脑活动与相机运动结合能够恢复未见房间的度量布局，是从fMRI重建人类所见三维空间的重要一步。

title: Where Do Long Captions Fail? Position-Aware Diagnosis and Reinforcement Learning for Detailed Image Captioning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages, 3 figures; includes references, appendices, and the paper checklist
summary: Detailed image captioning is usually framed as an amount problem: a model should mention more visual facts while avoiding hallucination. However, autoregressive VLMs generate captions as ordered sequences, and later generations may be produced under weaker or noisier visual grounding. We therefore argue that long-form captioning should be studied not only by what facts are mentioned, but also by where they appear. We introduce a position-aware rubric representation that decomposes dense human references into atomic visual claims, verifies generated captions against those claims, and induces a quartile-wise composition of supported, hallucinated, and generic content. This lens reveals two qualitatively different failures in long captions: models tend to produce unsupported specificity in the middle, while the final portion often escapes into vague, non-evidential language rather than simply accumulating more hallucination. A same-reference human control does not exhibit these patterns; additional human audits examine the visual validity of the induced labels. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose PAGER (Position-Aware Grounded Evidence Reinforcement), a GRPO training objective with separate signals for supported fine-grained middle evidence, evidence-bearing tail continuation, claim coverage, and content-aware length control. The result is a closed loop: the same ordered claim representation identifies where long captions fail and supplies the position-specific reward needed to repair those failures. Experiments on detailed-caption benchmarks show that PAGER improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference while preserving competitive global caption quality.

AI.tldr: 该工作指出长图像描述的问题不应只看“说了多少事实/是否幻觉”，还要看事实出现在序列的哪个位置；并提出位置感知的评测与强化学习方法 PAGER，修复长描述中段虚假具体性和尾段空泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 详细图像描述通常被建模为“量”的问题：让模型覆盖更多视觉事实并减少幻觉。但自回归多模态模型生成的是有序序列，后面的内容可能在更弱或更噪的视觉接地条件下生成，因此长描述的质量问题具有位置依赖性。作者认为需要同时分析“说了什么”和“说在哪里”。
AI.method: 作者提出 position-aware rubric representation：把密集人类参考描述分解为原子视觉主张，用这些主张验证生成描述，并按四分位统计支持、幻觉和泛化内容的构成。基于该诊断，提出 PAGER：一种位置感知强化学习训练目标，在 GRPO 框架中分别给予中段被支持的细粒度证据、尾部继续提供证据、主张覆盖以及内容感知长度控制等奖励信号。
AI.result: 分析发现长描述存在两类质变失败：中段倾向于产生无依据的具体表达，尾段则倾向逃避到空泛、非证据性语言，而不是简单堆积更多幻觉。同参考人类控制不出现这些模式。实验表明 PAGER 能改善位置相关的视觉接地的同时提升描述偏好，并保持有竞争力的整体描述质量。
AI.conclusion: 长图像描述质量需要位置感知评价，而不仅是事实数量或幻觉率。PAGER 通过同一原子主张表示既诊断失败位置，又提供位置特定奖励，形成“定位失败并修复失败”的闭环，为详细 captioning 的训练和评估提供了新方向。

title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
summary: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISM，一种基于语言语义建模的可解释程序性错误识别方法，通过视频片段语言描述、隐马尔可夫模型和编辑型错误标注实现多步骤任务中的错误检测与评估。
AI.motivation: 程序性错误识别需要判断执行过程是否偏离有效多步骤活动。现有视频基准在注释类型和错误定义上存在异质性，因此需要一种可解释、可跨数据集比较并能识别步骤内容错误与顺序错误的统一框架。
AI.method: 作者利用基准提供的步骤边界，对视频片段进行语言化描述，并训练轻量级隐马尔可夫模型将描述映射到程序状态。通过参考对齐和语义检查识别内容错误与顺序错误；同时建立插入、删除、替换和换位四类编辑型错误以统一多基准评估，并比较金标与VLM生成描述在原始、语义角色和动作—对象三种表示下的效果。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，训练得到的局部解码器相比最近候选匹配带来一致提升，序列解码也产生数据集依赖的额外收益。语义角色标注在六组匹配接地比较中均提升Any-F1，但不同数据集收益不一，且在独立配置选择下未表现出一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 语言接地可作为显式程序性错误推理的有效接口。该研究不仅提出PRISM，还进一步刻画了语义表示与解码策略对程序性错误识别性能的独立与组合贡献。

title: WildDepth-v2: A Synchronized RGB--LiDAR--Radar Dataset and Benchmark for Metric Depth, Motion, and Tracking of Wildlife
summary: Measuring animal distance and motion in metric units underpins abundance estimation, morphometrics, and movement ecology, yet monocular video lacks metric scale and wildlife datasets lack metric ground truth. We present WildDepth 2, extending the synchronized RGB-LiDAR WildDepth dataset in three directions. (i) Imaging radar: 37 RGB-LiDAR-4D-radar sequences (19,716 frames) with per-point Doppler velocity and a measured error budget, to our knowledge the first imaging-radar wildlife recordings. (ii) Benchmarking: a frozen, checksummed hidden test set for RGB-only distance estimation and RGB+sparse-LiDAR depth completion, evaluated separately on animal and background pixels. (iii) Motion and tracking: metric 3D trajectories obtained by lifting 2D tracks using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth. Across 48,723 animal frames, object-level radar calibration improves monocular depth over scene-level LiDAR calibration without requiring LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198), although animal-level LiDAR remains more accurate (0.052). Across 431 tracks, once-per-track radar scaling reduces 3D position error four-fold (2.20 to 0.58 m) and distance-sampling detection-function bias from -13% to -2%, matching once-per-track LiDAR calibration. Transferring radar Doppler onto LiDAR produces motion masks 3.7 times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, reduces moving-animal LiDAR accumulation error by 37%, and estimates radial speed (r = 0.60), albeit with approximately 50% underestimation.

AI.tldr: WildDepth 2 提出一个面向野生动物单目视频度量距离与运动估计的扩展数据集与基准，加入同步 RGB–LiDAR–4D 成像雷达序列、隐藏测试集和三维轨迹标注，并验证了成像雷达在无雷达推理场景下对单目深度与轨迹尺度校正的有效性。
AI.motivation: 野生动物生态、丰度估计、形态测量和运动生态研究需要在度量单位下估计动物距离和运动，但单目 RGB 视频缺乏绝对尺度，现有野生动物数据集也缺少度量真值。因此需要多传感器同步数据集、可复现基准，以及适合野外部署的距离/深度/轨迹尺度校正方法。
AI.method: 论文提出 WildDepth 2，从三个方面扩展 WildDepth 数据集：1）增加 37 个同步 RGB–LiDAR–4D 成像雷达序列，共 19,716 帧，并包含逐点雷达多普勒速度和实测误差预算；2）建立冻结且带校验和的隐藏测试集，用于评估仅 RGB 的距离估计以及 RGB 加稀疏 LiDAR 的深度补全，并分别统计动物像素和背景像素上的性能；3）利用 LiDAR、雷达或单目深度将二维轨迹提升为度量三维轨迹，并研究目标级雷达标定、单次轨迹尺度校正和雷达多普勒向 LiDAR 迁移用于运动掩码与径向速度估计。
AI.result: 在 48,723 个动物帧上，目标级雷达标定使单目深度估计的 AbsRel 从场景级 LiDAR 标定的 0.198 降到 0.120，说明推理时不需要 LiDAR 也能获得更可靠的单目深度尺度；但动物级 LiDAR 标定仍最准确，AbsRel 为 0.052。在 431 条轨迹上，每条轨迹一次雷达尺度校正将三维位置误差从 2.20 m 降低到 0.58 m，约四倍改善，并将距离采样检测函数偏倚从 -13% 减小到 -2%，接近单次轨迹 LiDAR 标定效果。将雷达多普勒迁移到 LiDAR 后，运动掩码比仅用雷达时稠密 3.7 倍，精度为 72%，并将移动动物相关的 LiDAR 累积误差降低 37%，同时可估计径向速度，相关系数 r = 0.60，但存在约 50% 的低估。
AI.conclusion: WildDepth 2 表明 4D 成像雷达可以作为野生动物单目视频距离、深度尺度和三维轨迹校正的有效传感器替代或补充。它在不依赖 LiDAR 推理的条件下显著改善单目深度与轨迹度量误差，并对丰度估计中的距离采样偏倚有明显校正；但雷达多普勒估计径向速度仍偏差较大，高精度动物尺度真值仍有待 LiDAR 或更强标注支持。

title: Pos4CHD: A Positive-Free Mask-Guided Counterfactual Synthesis Framework for Fetal Congenital Heart Defect Analysis
comment: Submitted to IEEE TMI, under review
summary: The scarcity of positive cases remains a major bottleneck in developing automated diagnostic systems for fetal Congenital Heart Defects~(CHDs), particularly for rare subtypes. Although normal cases are accessible with effort, positive cases are hard to collect due to low incidence rates and privacy concerns, causing severe class imbalance or absence of positive training samples. Existing works resort to synthesizing positives with conditional generative models, but they are task-specific and require positive training samples, hindering application for fetal CHDs. To this end, we propose a positive-free mask-guided counterfactual generation framework for fetal echocardiography, namely Pos4CHD, which enables realistic, high-quality synthesis of pseudo-positive samples from semantic masks, with only normal samples at hand. Technically, we first develop FE-Gen, a mask-guided generative model tailored for fetal heart ultrasound synthesis that mitigates histogram drift and enhances image-mask spatial alignment. Building on FE-Gen, Pos4CHD employs a mask-to-image generation paradigm for CHD synthesis. It first manipulates semantic masks to simulate fetal-heart structural anomalies and then renders anatomically consistent images. Extensive experiments on in-house datasets, together with expert evaluations, demonstrate the visual fidelity~($-12.97$ FID) and anatomical consistency~($+3.96\%$ DSC) of synthesized images. Further validations across diverse real-world CHD diagnosis tasks exhibit promising results and consistent increments, including zero-shot classification~(achieving $93.25\%$ ACC on EbA and $72.92\%$ ACC on TAPVC), lesion detection~($+6.95\%$ mAP50 on VSD), and anatomy segmentation~($+10.49\%$ DSC on fetal heart) compared with baselines. Codes and models are publicly available on \href{https://github.com/DREAMXFAR/Pos4CHD}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Pos4CHD，一种无需阳性样本的掩码引导反事实生成框架，仅利用正常胎儿超声心动图即可合成高质量伪阳性 CHD 图像，用于提升胎儿先天性心脏病的自动诊断。
AI.motivation: 胎儿先天性心脏病自动诊断长期受限于罕见阳性样本稀缺、采集成本高和隐私限制，导致类别严重不平衡甚至缺少阳性训练数据；现有生成方法通常需要阳性样本且任务特定，难以应用于罕见 CHD 子型。
AI.method: 首先构建面向胎儿心超的掩码引导生成模型 FE-Gen，缓解直方图漂移并增强图像与语义掩码的空间对齐；随后提出 Pos4CHD 的“掩码到图像”反事实合成范式：先操纵正常样本的语义掩码以模拟胎儿心脏结构异常，再生成解剖一致的伪阳性超声图像，从而实现 positive-free 合成。
AI.result: 在自建数据集和专家评估中，合成图像具有更高视觉保真度和解剖一致性，表现为 FID 降低 12.97、DSC 提升 3.96%。在下游真实 CHD 任务中也带来一致增益：EbA 零样本分类准确率 93.25%，TAPVC 72.92%，VSD 病灶检测 mAP50 提升 6.95%，胎儿心脏解剖分割 DSC 提升 10.49%。
AI.conclusion: Pos4CHD 展示了在仅有正常样本条件下生成高质量伪阳性胎儿心超图像的可行性，为缓解罕见 CHD 数据稀缺、提升零样本分类、病灶检测和解剖分割等诊断任务提供了有效数据增强或合成方案；代码和模型已开源。

title: GM-GReFEL: Geometry-Guided Spatiotemporal State-Space Learning for Robust Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Recognizing facial expressions in unconstrained video suffers from two coupled problems: self-attention grows quadratically in cost with clip length, and crowdsourced labels are noisy. We present GM-GReFEL, a spatiotemporal state-space network with a geometry-aware decision stage. Its Modulated GroupMamba backbone replaces a spatiotemporal Vision Transformer. Six channel groups are scanned separately, four over the frame plane and two over time, so the cost grows linearly with sequence length ($\mathcal{O}(N)$); after each layer, a Channel Affinity Modulation gate mixes the groups again. On top of the backbone, a GReFEL reliability module turns the normalized entropy of each prediction into a mixing weight between the classifier output and a vote from trainable geometric anchors, so that facial geometry counts for more when the network is unsure. The model is initialized by static-to-dynamic weight transfer and trained with a Triple Loss. In five-fold cross-validation, the best fold scores 66.57\%/76.46\% UAR/WAR on DFEW, 0.3 points or less below the strongest compared method, and 45.66\%/62.27\% on MAFW, ahead of all compared methods; on FERV39k the mean over five splits, 42.30\%/52.66\%, is competitive. The five-fold means are 64.07\%/74.54\% on DFEW, on par with recent large pre-trained models, and 38.90\%/54.37\% on MAFW, below the best of them. A paired $t$-test on DFEW indicates a modest benefit of temporal modeling (+1.61 UAR points, one-sided $p=0.031$). Attention stays on plausible facial regions, and latency is close to a ViT-B/16 baseline (47.4 vs.\ 46.8 ms per clip). Code: https://github.com/ardiytama/GroupMamba-DFER.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GM-GReFEL，面向无约束视频中的面部表情识别：用线性复杂度的 Modulated GroupMamba 时空状态空间骨干替代 ViT，并通过 GReFEL 可靠性模块让几何信息在模型不确定时参与决策，以缓解长序列计算开销和众包标签噪声问题。
AI.motivation: 无约束视频表情识别面临两个耦合难题：一是自注意力在视频片段长度上的平方复杂度导致计算昂贵；二是众包数据中的标签噪声使模型难以稳定学习可靠的面部动态表征。作者希望通过线性时间复杂度的时空建模与几何感知的决策机制，同时提升效率和标签鲁棒性。
AI.method: 方法核心包括两部分。首先，Modulated GroupMamba 骨干将特征通道分为六组，其中四组在空间帧平面上扫描、两组在时间维度上扫描，使序列长度复杂度从自注意力的平方降为 O(N)，并在每层后通过 Channel Affinity Modulation 门控重新混合各通道组。其次，GReFEL 可靠性模块将每个预测的归一化熵转换为混合权重，在分类器输出与可训练几何锚点投票之间进行加权融合，使模型在不确定时更多依赖面部几何信息。模型通过静态到动态权重迁移初始化，并使用 Triple Loss 训练。
AI.result: 在 DFEW 上，最佳折取得 66.57%/76.46% UAR/WAR，与最强对比方法差距不超过 0.3 个百分点；在 MAFW 上取得 45.66%/62.27%，优于所有对比方法；在 FERV39k 上五个划分的平均结果为 42.30%/52.66%，具有竞争力。五折平均方面，DFEW 为 64.07%/74.54%，与近期大规模预训练模型相当；MAFW 为 38.90%/54.37%，低于最佳预训练模型。配对 t 检验显示时间建模带来 +1.61 UAR 的适度收益。注意力可视化较合理，单片段延迟 47.4 ms，接近 ViT-B/16 的 46.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: GM-GReFEL 表明，在 unconstrained FER 中，用 GroupMamba 式线性时空建模替代 ViT，并加入熵引导的几何可靠性门控，可以在几乎不增加延迟的情况下取得竞争性性能，尤其对噪声标签和长视频成本问题提供了有效缓解。但论文也显示其相对大预训练模型的优势有限，说明该方法更适合作为高效鲁棒的架构改进方向，而非单纯追求最高识别精度。

title: RankAlign: Vision-Language Representation Alignment via Rank Transformation
summary: While the Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that vision and language models converge toward compatible latent geometries, recovering class-level correspondences between unpaired modalities without cross-modal supervision remains challenging. Existing relational matching methods compare within-modality similarity kernels directly, although the same semantic structure may be represented through different numerical parameterizations across modalities. We propose RankAlign, a rank-based normalization strategy for class-level unpaired vision-language matching. RankAlign transforms each within-modality similarity kernel into an ordinal relational representation before permutation matching, while leaving the correspondence space and matching solver unchanged. The resulting representation is invariant to strictly increasing reparameterizations of similarity values while preserving the ordinal structure used for matching. We provide exact-recovery and stability guarantees that characterize correspondence recovery under both exact and partial ordinal agreement. Experiments across diverse frozen vision and language encoders and multiple datasets demonstrate improved and more stable class-level correspondence recovery, including under label corruption and domain shift.

AI.tldr:
本文提出 RankAlign，一种面向无配对视觉—语言类级匹配的顺序/秩归一化方法，通过将模态内相似度核转为保持顺序但不依赖具体数值尺度的关系表示，提升跨模态类别对应恢复的稳定性与准确性。</tldr>

<parameter name="motivation">尽管视觉模型和语言模型可能逐渐收敛到可兼容的潜在几何结构，但在没有跨模态监督的情况下，如何从未配对的视觉和语言表示中恢复“类级对应关系”仍然困难。现有关系匹配方法通常直接比较各模态内部的相似度核；然而，同一语义结构在不同模态中可能以不同的数值参数化方式呈现，直接比较数值相似度容易受到尺度、分布或编码差异影响，导致对应关系不稳定。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉模型和语言模型可能逐渐收敛到可兼容的潜在几何结构，但在没有跨模态监督的情况下，如何从未配对的视觉和语言表示中恢复“类级对应关系”仍然困难。现有关系匹配方法通常直接比较各模态内部的相似度核；然而，同一语义结构在不同模态中可能以不同的数值参数化方式呈现，直接比较数值相似度容易受到尺度、分布或编码差异影响，导致对应关系不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 RankAlign：在排列匹配之前，将每个模态内部的相似度核转换为其“顺序关系表示”，即只保留相似度大小次序，而消除具体数值差异。该方法不改变对应空间，也不更换匹配求解器，因此可以嵌入现有无配对视觉—语言匹配流程。其关键性质是对相似度的严格单调重参数化保持不变，同时保留匹配所需的顺序结构。理论方面给出在完全顺序一致和部分顺序一致条件下对应关系恢复的精确恢复与稳定性保证。实验覆盖多种冻结的视觉与语言编码器及多个数据集，并考察标签噪声和域偏移场景。
AI.result: 在不同冻结编码器和数据集上，RankAlign 能比直接比较相似度核的传统关系匹配方法取得更高、更稳定的类级对应恢复效果，尤其在标签污染和域偏移条件下表现更稳健。
AI.conclusion: RankAlign 通过秩/顺序归一化缓解了跨模态相似度数值参数化不一致的问题，为无监督、无配对视觉—语言类级匹配提供了更鲁棒的关系表示和理论支持。该结果表明：跨模态对应关系可能更依赖于序数结构，而非原始相似度数值。

title: WildFakeToolBench: Benchmarking AI-Generated Image Detectors with Web-Sourced Image Processing
summary: As AI generated images are getting popular these days, discussions on such generations are widely existed in current public forums, software repositories, and photography tutorials. Moreover, with the help of LLM-assisted code translation, malicious actors can adopt such information to evade detectors without specialized knowledge or local GPU execution of the resulting tools. To evaluate such risks, we introduce \textsc{WildFakeToolBench}, a benchmark suite of $156$ executable image-processing tools derived from $220$ public sources across $142$ domains. Each tool retains its source evidence and passes syntax, execution, and output-distortion checks without using feedback from the evaluated detectors. On $105$ generated images from five generators, we evaluate six state-of-the-art detectors with images processed by the tools in our collected bench to assess their effectiveness against such in-the-wild risks. The strongest individual tools achieve attack success rates of $25.25\%$--$100\%$ across detectors, exceeding the strongest of six selected image-processing baselines for each detector. Evaluating subsets of an eight-tool pool yields worst-case coverage above $80\%$ for every detector. Effectiveness is sparse and detector-specific: high coverage across candidates does not imply reliable one-shot evasion. These findings not only highlight the potential of such web-sourced risks, but also show the potential on establishing AI-image detector robustness evaluation framework based on those in-the-wild information.

AI.tldr: 该摘要介绍了一个用于评估真实网络信息如何被恶意利用以规避AI生成图像检测器的基准套件 WildFakeToolBench，并通过156个可执行图像处理工具量化了这种“in-the-wild”攻击风险。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像日益普及，相关讨论、工具实现和教程广泛存在于公开论坛、代码仓库和摄影教程中；LLM辅助代码翻译使攻击者无需专业知识或本地GPU即可利用这些信息，因此需要评估其对AI图像检测器的规避威胁。
AI.method: 作者收集220个公开来源、覆盖142个领域，构建包含156个可执行图像处理工具的基准套件，并保留来源证据，通过语法、执行和输出失真检查且不依赖被评检测器反馈；随后在5个生成器生成的105张图像上，使用6个先进检测器评估工具处理后图像的检测规避效果。
AI.result: 最强单个工具在多个检测器上达到25.25%至100%的攻击成功率，优于所选6种图像处理基线中每种检测器对应的最强基线；由8个工具组成池中评估子集时，对所有检测器的最坏情况覆盖率均超过80%，但有效性具有稀疏性和检测器特异性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了基于网络公开信息构建AI生成图像检测规避风险的重要潜力，也表明此类真实场景信息可用于建立AI图像检测器鲁棒性评估框架。

title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
summary: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“以视频为中心的深入研究报告生成”任务与 OmniDR-Bench 基准，通过技能化工作流和 Omni-ARTs 原子评分树评估智能体从视频、多模态证据与交互报告中综合研究的能力，发现当前最佳智能体仅得 63.3/100，仍存在内容覆盖、跨模态因果逻辑分析和引用准确性不足等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体主要评估开放网页证据整合为长报告的能力，但缺少以真实源视频为中心、需要音视频理解、外部多模态证据检索、事实核验和交互呈现的评测。该任务对用户定位视频关键时刻、验证声明、复现操作流程和做出决策具有实际价值。
AI.method: 作者提出以视频和用户请求为输入的 Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation 任务，设计技能化工作流，使智能体识别研究问题、检索外部多模态证据并生成与视频相关时刻链接的交互式报告。评估方面引入 Omni Atomic Rubric Trees（Omni-ARTs），包含三个维度、23个共享方向以及任务特定原子二元标准；通过 Audited Rubric Construction（ARC）以独立证据收集、自动检查、行为校准和迭代人工审核构建评分树，并构建包含50个中英任务和6414条标准、覆盖19个真实子类别的 OmniDR-Bench。
AI.result: 在18种智能体配置上，最佳系统得分为63.3/100，表明当前智能体尚未充分解决该任务。模型仍需要更广的内容覆盖、更强的跨模态因果与逻辑分析能力，以及更准确的引用支持。论文还进一步分析了模型、harness、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了视频中心深度研究报告生成这一新评测任务，并提供了可审计、细粒度、多模态的基准与评估框架。结果说明现有视频多模态智能体在证据整合、逻辑推理和可验证引用方面仍距实用化有明显差距，未来研究需提升跨模态分析与精确溯源能力。

title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
summary: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiSTEVE，一个分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）智能体与能力感知的智能体框架，用于在Minecraft等开放世界游戏中同时实现长时序自主规划与原生键鼠界面控制，并在多项基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 构建能在开放世界游戏中像人类一样自主行动的智能体是长期目标。现有智能体通常只能二选一：要么具备原生视觉运动控制但缺乏长时序自主性，要么具备高层规划但依赖环境API或预定义技能，难以像真实玩家那样通过图形界面直接操作。
AI.method: HiSTEVE采用分层架构。在编排层，引入能力感知的智能体框架，包括用于追踪进度的结构化记忆和用于选择VLA能力范围内子任务的视觉语言模型规划器；并设计策略耦合的任务完成状态检测器，利用VLA策略上下文判断候选子任务是否完成。在控制层，使用单个VLA完成所有子任务，仅依赖视觉感知和原生键鼠动作。为缓解GUI与非GUI交互之间的干扰，引入分场景RMSNorm分支和独立的鼠标移动token嵌入。训练上结合世界知识注入、模仿学习和基于环境反馈的强化学习，以提升可靠性和失败恢复能力。
AI.result: HiSTEVE在原子任务性能上达到最先进水平，在MineStudio Bench上取得85.0%得分，在OpenHA上取得37.4%的平均成功率；同时能够完成从零采集资源并合成铁镐等长时序任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过分层VLA与能力感知调度框架，有效弥合了长时序自主规划与原生界面控制之间的差距，为在开放世界中训练接近人类玩家操作方式的游戏智能体提供了可行路径。

title: RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
summary: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RaSFNet，通过光线对齐几何编码、扫描拓扑感知Mamba和距离约束点-视锥融合，提升投影式LiDAR点云语义分割的空间几何与范围一致性。
AI.motivation: 投影式LiDAR语义分割虽便于使用2D网络，但存在视锥内多点聚合导致几何差异被掩盖、局部特征提取难以建模跨扫描区域空间关系、投影距离不代表三维距离、以及点特征与投影特征融合时混合不同距离信息等不足，从而削弱语义判别能力。
AI.method: 提出Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network（RaSFNet）。其中，RAGDE在光线对齐坐标系下编码每个视锥内的点分布；STAM按LiDAR方位角采样模式组织视锥特征，并捕获跨扫描区域长程依赖；RCPFF利用共享距离信息引导点特征与视锥特征交互，同时保持空间对应与范围约束。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别达到70.2%和77.7% mIoU，相比所评测方法具有竞争性语义分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 将点云几何分布、LiDAR扫描拓扑和距离感知融合机制引入投影式分割框架，可缓解传统投影方法中几何信息丢失、空间上下文不足和跨范围特征混淆问题，提升LiDAR点云语义分割效果。

title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Under review at npj digital medicine
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个面向视网膜OCT生物标志物视觉定位的基准RetinaGroundBench、新指标AggIoU，并训练RetGrounder，揭示当前多模态大模型在医学图像定位上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: MLLM虽能回答临床问题，但可信临床使用要求其真正定位所报告的病灶而非依赖捷径。MLLM在视网膜OCT中的视觉定位能力此前研究很少。
AI.method: 构建包含815张B-scans、4,537个框、13类生物标志物和8种疾病的专家标注基准；提出AggIoU以处理模型对单一病灶产生多个部分预测框的问题；评测27个开源MLLM，并通过融合定位与文本信息的OCT特定微调策略开发RetGrounder。
AI.result: 当前MLLM定位能力仍远未解决：最佳通用模型宏观F1仅23.7%，recall持续偏低，但其生物标志物存在性问题的平衡准确率最高达73%；8B参数RetGrounder将定位F1提升至33.9%，相对提升43%。
AI.conclusion: RetinaGroundBench为评估MLLM在OCT诊断中的定位能力提供了参考基准，表明视觉定位仍是关键瓶颈，而面向医学影像的专门化微调可显著提升性能。

title: Moving Regions, Not Moving Objects: Segmenting What Actually Moves under Camera Motion
comment: Project page and video demonstrations: https://kosmoresearch.github.io/MoRSe/
summary: Moving object segmentation is conventionally formulated at the sequence and object level, marking an entire instance as moving once it moves anywhere in a video. Recent instantaneous formulations distinguish moving from stationary intervals, but still generate masks at the object level through frozen segmentation foundation models. Because the mask is derived from an instance-level proposal, motion is typically attributed to the entire instance rather than localized to the regions that actually move. Moreover, such instance-level predictions can produce masks even when no part of the instance is actually moving, revealing a more fundamental issue: motion is not an intrinsic property of an instance; it can only be determined by comparing at least two frames. Building on this premise, we introduce MoRSe, which jointly interprets two frames to predict a moving-region mask, distinguishing actual scene motion from apparent motion induced by the camera. A single RGB encoder replaces multi-stage foundation stacks, so no optical flow, point tracks, or separate mask generator is needed at inference. We release MoRSe-5K, a benchmark of 42 sequences with Static, Dynamic-Static, and Dynamic settings designed to evaluate the model's ability to distinguish and localize moving and stationary regions under different camera and scene motion conditions. MoRSe outperforms both specialized moving object segmentation methods and dense 4D reconstruction methods with motion-thresholded predictions, while producing the fewest false positives on sequences where nothing moves.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MoRSe，一种联合解释两帧图像并直接预测局部运动区域掩码的方法，能够区分真实场景运动与相机引起的表观运动，无需光流、点轨迹或独立掩码生成器。
AI.motivation: 传统运动目标分割通常以整个目标实例为单位判断是否运动，容易将局部运动归因于整体；同时，实例级预测可能在目标完全静止时仍输出掩码，暴露出“运动并非实例固有属性，而需由至少两帧比较确定”的根本问题。现有瞬时方法虽可区分运动与静止区间，但仍依赖冻结分割基础模型生成实例级掩码，难以精确刻画局部运动并减少假阳性。
AI.method: 论文提出MoRSe，以双帧联合解释为核心，预测运动区域掩码，从而将运动定位到真正变化的局部区域，并区分场景真实运动与相机运动造成的表观运动。模型采用单一RGB编码器替代多阶段分割基础模型堆栈，推理阶段不需要光流、点轨迹或单独掩码生成器。论文还发布MoRSe-5K基准，包含42个序列，并设置Static、Dynamic-Static、Dynamic三类条件，用于评估不同相机与场景运动条件下模型区分和定位运动/静止区域的能力。
AI.result: MoRSe在性能上优于专门用于运动目标分割的方法，也优于基于运动阈值的密集4D重建方法。特别是在没有物体运动的序列上，MoRSe产生的假阳性最少，表明其能更可靠地抑制无运动场景中的误检。
AI.conclusion: 运动分割应从实例级判断转向区域级、帧对比较的建模方式。MoRSe通过双帧联合解释和轻量编码结构实现了更细粒度的运动定位与更低假阳性，证明运动应被视为由帧间差异确定的局部现象，而非目标实例的固有属性。

title: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and perceptually faithful images from severely degraded observations. Recent diffusion-based generative methods achieve strong perceptual quality by leveraging powerful image priors, but their iterative sampling incurs substantial computational cost, limiting practical deployment. Despite recent efficiency gains in generative LLIE, high-quality enhancement with a single function evaluation and low overall computation remains challenging, particularly under diverse real-world low-light conditions. We introduce GLOW-FM, a one-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient generative LLIE. GLOW-FM performs conditional transport in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE and leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) to enable enhancement with a single function evaluation. Matched comparisons with alternative one-step objectives support TVM as an effective design choice, and, to the best of our knowledge, this is its first adaptation to image restoration and specifically to LLIE. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GLOW-FM achieves competitive image quality and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization while requiring only a single function evaluation and 34 GFLOPs for the small variant. These findings highlight the potential of GLOW-FM to bring generative LLIE closer to practical deployment through single-step inference and compact latent modeling. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GLOW-FM，一个面向低光图像增强的高效一步潜在流匹配框架。它在冻结的 Tiny-VAE 潜空间中执行条件传输，并采用 Terminal Velocity Matching（TVM）实现单次函数评估增强，在真实低光基准上取得有竞争力的生成质量和领先的跨数据集泛化能力，同时显著降低推理计算成本。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强需要在严重退化输入下恢复曝光正常、感知可信的图像。扩散类生成方法虽然能借助强大图像先验获得高质量结果，但通常需要多步迭代采样，计算开销大，不利于实际部署。尽管已有生成式方法在效率上取得进展，如何在多样化的真实低光场景中同时实现高质量、单步推理和低总体计算量仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 作者提出 GLOW-FM，将低光图像增强建模为潜空间中的一步条件传输问题。框架使用冻结的 Tiny-VAE 进行紧凑潜变量表示，避免直接对高维像素空间建模；在潜空间中根据条件输入进行生成式增强。关键设计是 Terminal Velocity Matching（TVM），使模型能够在单次函数评估中完成增强。论文还比较了其他一步优化目标，以验证 TVM 的有效性，并将其首次适配到图像恢复及低光图像增强任务中。整体流程强调单步推理和小计算量，其小型变体仅需约 34 GFLOPs。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的真实世界低光图像增强基准上，GLOW-FM 展现了与现有方法相当的图像质量，并在跨数据集泛化方面达到最先进水平。与需要多步采样的生成式方法相比，该方法只需一次函数评估即可完成增强，其中小型变体的计算量约为 34 GFLOPs，体现了更高的推理效率和部署潜力。
AI.conclusion: GLOW-FM 表明，一步流匹配、紧凑潜空间建模和 TVM 目标可以有效缓解生成式低光图像增强中的计算瓶颈。该工作为面向实际应用的低光图像增强提供了单步、低计算且泛化能力强的方案，显示生成式恢复方法在真实部署场景中的可行性。

title: Lightweight Frame Compensation for Real-Time Polyp Segmentation under Frame Skipping
summary: Real-time polyp segmentation in computer-assisted colonoscopy is hampered by the difficulty of deploying high-accuracy models under strict latency budgets. Frame skipping, which performs inference every K frames and reuses or interpolates the rest, improves throughput but introduces motion blur and lesion misalignment that degrade temporal consistency. To close this gap, we propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC), a 77K-parameter plug-and-play module inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Operating on a three-frame window, LFC fuses consecutive frames via spatio-temporal attention into a single compensated frame, and is trained only on pseudo-labels generated by a differently seeded model, without any expert annotation. Experiments on three polyp video benchmarks show that LFC recovers most of the accuracy degraded by direct frame skipping and, in several settings, reaches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while retaining a 2.05X--2.55X throughput gain. We further evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones spanning CNN, pyramid Transformer, and global-attention Transformer architectures, revealing a spectrum of sensitivity to frame skipping that arises from how locally or globally each architecture aggregates misaligned input. The compensation gain of LFC follows this spectrum: it is largest for high-capacity Transformer backbones, which achieve the best static accuracy but suffer the most under skip-frame inference. LFC thus offers a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly route to real-time polyp segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种超轻量、可插拔的帧补偿模块LFC，用于缓解结肠镜息肉分割中跳帧推理带来的时序退化，在保持2.05X–2.55X吞吐提升的同时恢复大部分精度。
AI.motivation: 计算机辅助结肠镜中的实时息肉分割需要在严格延迟预算内部署高精度模型。跳帧推理可提高吞吐，但会因运动模糊和病灶错位破坏帧间一致性，导致分割精度和时序稳定性下降。作者希望在不替换或微调重型分割骨干、不依赖专家标注的前提下，用极轻量模块补偿跳帧造成的时序误差。
AI.method: 作者设计Lightweight Frame Compensator（LFC），是一个77K参数的即插即用模块，插入到冻结的分割骨干之前。LFC在连续三帧窗口上运行，通过时空注意力融合相邻帧，生成单帧“补偿帧”，再输入骨干进行分割。训练时仅使用另一个不同随机种子的模型生成的伪标签，无需人工专家标注。作者在三个息肉视频基准上评估，并比较CNN、Pyramid Transformer和global-attention Transformer三类骨干在跳帧下的时序稳定性与补偿收益。
AI.result: 实验表明，LFC能够恢复直接跳帧推理造成的多数精度损失，在某些设置下接近逐帧推理精度，同时保留约2.05X至2.55X的吞吐量提升。三类骨干对跳帧的敏感度呈现谱系差异：静态精度较高、全局建模能力较强的高容量Transformer骨干在跳帧时下降最明显，但也获得最大的LFC补偿收益。
AI.conclusion: LFC为实时息肉分割提供了一种低参数、无需专家标注、可插拔且部署友好的折中方案。该研究还揭示不同网络结构在跳帧推理下具有不同的时序稳定性，并说明轻量补偿模块可特别缓解高容量Transformer骨干在实时跳帧场景中的精度下降。

title: Reinforcing intra-operative tumour localisation with weak supervision from pre-operative appearances
summary: Limited tumour visibility on intra-operative images complicates surgical navigation, including liver hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) targeting on computed tomography (CT) imaging. This makes labelled datasets difficult to curate for deep learning, and transferring pre-operative delineations through registration remains challenging due to intra-operative deformation and lack of paired pre- and intra-operative data. We propose to transfer tumour appearances learned from pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images to guide localisation on intra-operative CT through weak supervision. A classifier is trained to classify tumour presence on pre-operative images. This is applied to windows on intra-operative images, and despite the domain gap, it assigns higher tumour-presence probabilities on average to tumour-containing windows. These weak cross-domain signals guide a reinforcement learning agent to localise tumours on intra-operative images.
